title: Every identified risk shall be systematically assessed against the pre-establish…
text: Every identified risk shall be systematically assessed against the pre-established risk acceptance criteria to determine whether it can be accepted as-is or shall be subjected to treatment measures.

section: 4.7 Product Cybersecurity Risk Evaluation and Risk Acceptance
title: A risk may be deemed acceptable only when it demonstrably aligns with the predet…
text: A risk may be deemed acceptable only when it demonstrably aligns with the predetermined risk acceptance criteria defined in 5.3. Risks that do not meet these criteria shall not be accepted, regardless of other considerations such as cost or feasibility.

section: 4.7 Product Cybersecurity Risk Evaluation and Risk Acceptance
title: When residual risks are shared with users - because the product relies on the op…
text: When residual risks are shared with users - because the product relies on the operational environment or user action to provide necessary controls - it shall be verified that the required user mitigations are realistic and achievable for the intended user base, given their expected knowledge and capability. Risk acceptance under these conditions is contingent on this verification.

section: 4.7 Product Cybersecurity Risk Evaluation and Risk Acceptance
title: For each accepted or residual risk, a documented acceptance justification shall …
text: For each accepted or residual risk, a documented acceptance justification shall be produced and retained explaining why the risk is considered acceptable. This justification shall reference the risk acceptance criteria from 5.3 and shall describe any conditions of use or operational environment assumptions on which the acceptance is predicated.

title: For every risk that does not satisfy the established risk acceptance criteria, a…
text: For every risk that does not satisfy the established risk acceptance criteria, a treatment option that is appropriate to the product context shall be applied.

title: For each risk subject to treatment, documentation shall be made of the treatment…
text: For each risk subject to treatment, documentation shall be made of the treatment option selected and the justification for why that option is appropriate given the product context together with the applicable risk acceptance criteria.

title: Following the application of any risk treatment measure, the affected risks shal…
text: Following the application of any risk treatment measure, the affected risks shall be reevaluated to determine whether residual risks indeed meet the established acceptance criteria.

title: Risk communication directed at users shall employ language and methods appropria…
text: Risk communication directed at users shall employ language and methods appropriate to the audience; where the audience consists of consumers, the language used shall be clear and free of technical jargon to the extent practicable.

title: Where a product is subject to applicable accessibility obligations or where the …
text: Where a product is subject to applicable accessibility obligations or where the intended user base includes individuals with impairments, risk communication shall consider formats and using language to ensure each user can meaningfully access the information.

title: Risk communication documentation shall address a minimum set of elements: the ci…
text: Risk communication documentation shall address a minimum set of elements: the circumstances and foreseeable misuse scenarios that could give rise to significant cybersecurity risks; the mitigation measures users are expected to implement; and the operational conditions under which the product may be used securely.

title: Reviews of product cybersecurity risk management activities shall be conducted a…
text: Reviews of product cybersecurity risk management activities shall be conducted at planned intervals, where the frequency of those intervals is determined by the risk assessment and the context in which the product operates, and at least once a year - despite design staying the same.

title: In addition to planned-interval reviews, a review of risk management activities …
text: In addition to planned-interval reviews, a review of risk management activities shall be initiated when trigger conditions are met, including product modification, context changes, changes to risk acceptance criteria, changes in cybersecurity risk exposure (including threat landscape changes), identification of a known exploitable vulnerability, occurrence of a severe incident, or obsolescence of a component with cybersecurity impact.

title: Where a review conducted under 5.10-CR-01 or 5.10-CR-02 reveals that existing ri…
text: Where a review conducted under 5.10-CR-01 or 5.10-CR-02 reveals that existing risk assessment documentation is affected, the relevant documentation produced under Clause 5 shall be updated accordingly.

title: The product cybersecurity plan shall take the product context from 5.2 into acco…
text: The product cybersecurity plan shall take the product context from 5.2 into account, when available, and define, at minimum, every applicable cybersecurity activity defined in Clauses 6 and 7.

title: Throughout the entire product lifecycle, the product cybersecurity plan shall be…
text: Throughout the entire product lifecycle, the product cybersecurity plan shall be kept current through regular maintenance and review, and the execution of all planned activities shall be actively tracked. Review shall take place not only on a regular schedule but also upon occurrence of defined triggers.

title: Product cybersecurity requirements shall be derived from and grounded in the pro…
text: Product cybersecurity requirements shall be derived from and grounded in the product context, the decisions made regarding treatment of product cybersecurity risks, and all applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Whenever any of the defined inputs - product context, risk assessment outcomes, …
text: Whenever any of the defined inputs - product context, risk assessment outcomes, risk treatment decisions, or applicable regulatory requirements - undergo change, the product cybersecurity requirements shall be reviewed and updated as necessary to remain current and accurate.

title: Changes to product cybersecurity requirements shall be communicated to all affec…
text: Changes to product cybersecurity requirements shall be communicated to all affected development, testing, and operations teams in a timely and documented manner, with impact assessment by each affected party.

title: A specification of the product's cybersecurity architecture and design shall be …
text: A specification of the product's cybersecurity architecture and design shall be produced. This specification shall include the selection of cybersecurity controls chosen to satisfy the cybersecurity requirements established in 6.3.

title: The product shall be developed and maintained securely by using a secure develop…
text: The product shall be developed and maintained securely by using a secure development environment to prevent unauthorized access, to an extent appropriate given the product's risk profile, design, and scope. This shall be demonstrated by including the development environment in the scope of the provider’s Information Security Management System certified against ISO/IEC 27001 by an accredited certification body.

title: The product shall implement all cybersecurity requirements established in 6.3, i…
text: The product shall implement all cybersecurity requirements established in 6.3, in conformance with the cybersecurity architecture and design defined in 6.4.

title: A documented secure coding standard shall be adopted and enforced, applicable to…
text: A documented secure coding standard shall be adopted and enforced, applicable to the programming languages and frameworks used in the mobile application, covering at minimum: prohibited functions, memory safety practices, input validation, output encoding, error handling, preventing common security weaknesses, and prohibition of hard-coded credentials.

title: A process shall be established for identifying, reviewing, and approving the use…
text: A process shall be established for identifying, reviewing, and approving the use of memoryunsafe programming languages or constructs in the mobile application, and shall document the rationale and compensating controls where their use cannot be avoided.

title: Where secure implementation activities produce deviations from the cybersecurity…
text: Where secure implementation activities produce deviations from the cybersecurity architecture and design, reviews shall be triggered of the cybersecurity risk management activities, as defined in 5.10 and all affected cybersecurity product lifecycle activities.

title: The product shall use cryptographic mechanisms that reflect the state of the art…
text: The product shall use cryptographic mechanisms that reflect the state of the art and that conform to the cryptographic requirements applicable to the product and agreed within its certification, regulatory, or sectoral context - covering the selection of algorithms, parameters, key sizes, operational modes, random number generation, key lifecycle management, and the deprecation policy. Where the applicable requirements do not designate a specific cryptographic reference, the agreed cryptographic mechanisms defined in the ECCG “Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms” (ACM) shall be used as the recognised baseline. Where the product is subject to a European Digital Identity Wallet certification scheme or to the EUCC, the applicable ACM version is the one required by that scheme (via the EUCC “Guidelines on Cryptography”) at the time of the conformity assessment or surveillance evaluation; versions issued as drafts or for public review are excluded until adopted. Where the applicable requirements or the ACM do not address a specific mechanism, equivalent state-of-the-art cryptographic guidance shall be applied. Continued conformity as the applicable requirements or the applicable ACM version evolve shall be maintained in accordance with 6.5-CR-09.

title: The product shall protect cryptographic keys through secure hardware modules. If…
text: The product shall protect cryptographic keys through secure hardware modules. If hardwarebased protection is not feasible, the product shall use secure software modules to protect cryptographic keys.

title: A process shall be established for inventorying and verifying all locations in t…
text: A process shall be established for inventorying and verifying all locations in the mobile application and its RDPS where cryptographic keys are generated, stored, used, and destroyed. Verification shall ensure that each location meets the cryptographic requirements in this document.

title: A process shall be established for periodically reviewing the protocol inventory…
text: A process shall be established for periodically reviewing the protocol inventory (see technical documentation in 6.6) against current state-of-the-art guidance and for identifying protocols that have been deprecated, are vulnerable, or require compensating measures in accordance with 6.5-CR-10.

title: When the product relies on legacy or vulnerable protocols, the product shall imp…
text: When the product relies on legacy or vulnerable protocols, the product shall implement security measures mitigating protocol issues - such as, but not limited to, multi-factor authentication - sufficient to maintain a security level commensurate with the risks introduced by those protocols.

title: The product shall maintain an identified list of all integrated components inclu…
text: The product shall maintain an identified list of all integrated components including at least the top-level dependencies and the transitive dependencies when technically feasible, in a commonly used machine-readable format. This is referred to as an SBOM (Software Bill Of Materials). A list entry shall include the type of dependency, software producer, unique component identifier (e.g. producer, component name, and component version). The SBOM shall contain the identity of the SBOM author, a version indicator, and a timestamp. When integrating third-party components, the intended purpose and user instructions to address cybersecurity risks of those components are the conditions that shall be adhered to.

title: A mapping of upstream dependencies and interdependencies, apart from components,…
text: A mapping of upstream dependencies and interdependencies, apart from components, shall be available to support coordination and notification when a vulnerability is discovered, so that related issues can be resolved without undue delay. In case the application employs AI models, any externally supplied element for this employment shall be part of this mapping, including third-party models, training data, augmentation data, MCP servers and agentic skills.

title: If a new software build or release is created, or if an inaccuracy is found in t…
text: If a new software build or release is created, or if an inaccuracy is found in the current SBOM, a revised SBOM shall be issued.

title: Technical documentation and user instructions shall be written in language easil…
text: Technical documentation and user instructions shall be written in language easily understood by the user and shall include at least: a) documentation of all logical and physical interfaces and transport protocols with their security properties; b) cybersecurity prerequisites for the deployment environment; c) a description of implemented security functions; d) usage instructions covering installation and hardening; e) data deletion and decommissioning procedures; and f) detailed configuration and maintenance instructions. These topics shall at least cover when applicable: configuration baselines, safe defaults, backup and restore, patching and updating, key rotation, log management including synchronization of time, incident response hooks, and interactions with platform security services (iOS Keychain, Android Keystore, biometric APIs, app sandboxing).

title: The product's technical documentation shall provide a detailed specification of …
text: The product's technical documentation shall provide a detailed specification of all cryptographic mechanisms employed, including the algorithms used, their parameters, key sizes, operational modes, random generation methods, key lifecycle management, and policy of deprecation.

title: The product's technical documentation shall include an artefact - such as a cove…
text: The product's technical documentation shall include an artefact - such as a coverage matrix - that explicitly links each identified risk to the security function or functions that address it.

title: Verification and validation shall take key elements as input: • the product impl…
text: Verification and validation shall take key elements as input: • the product implementation including relevant hardware, software, and remote data processing solutions; • the technical documentation, together with user information and instructions; • the cybersecurity requirements; • the product cybersecurity context including relevant information about use from for example customer input and support cases; • the cybersecurity state-of-the art as described in publications, standards, and guidelines; • the evolving threat landscape applicable to the product, including information on vulnerabilities found in similar products including components.

title: The cybersecurity verification and validation process shall confirm that the pro…
text: The cybersecurity verification and validation process shall confirm that the product is sufficiently secure, meaning it satisfies the cybersecurity requirements established in 6.3 and the levels of the identified risks (see 5.5) meet the acceptance criteria (see 5.3).

title: Threat scenarios and attack profiles shall be defined, documented, and used as t…
text: Threat scenarios and attack profiles shall be defined, documented, and used as the basis for validation testing, derived from the applicable attack potential level (e.g., AVA_VAN level), the risk assessment and the product's cybersecurity context . Each validation testing cycle, these shall be reviewed. The validation testing shall include advanced penetration testing calibrated to the goal, and specialized techniques - including where applicable protocol robustness testing, deep fuzzing, verification of hardened configurations, testing of secure boot/attestation, assessment of hardware key protection, and verifying supply chain integrity. A process for conducting these penetration tests shall be defined including: the scope of testing (including the mobile client, associated RDPS, and communication channels), the minimum qualifications required of testers, the testing methodology to be followed, and the criteria for determining when re-testing is required following remediation.

title: The V&V process shall validate that all cybersecurity risks associated with inte…
text: The V&V process shall validate that all cybersecurity risks associated with integrated components - including third-party software - have been identified and adequately addressed in the product's implemented design.

title: A process shall be established for assessing supply chain integrity as part of c…
text: A process shall be established for assessing supply chain integrity as part of cybersecurity V&V, including verification that the application binary and its dependencies are built from verified sources, that the build pipeline is protected against tampering, and that the deployed artefact matches the verified build output.

title: Where appropriate to the product's design, risk assessment, and cybersecurity co…
text: Where appropriate to the product's design, risk assessment, and cybersecurity context, the V&V process shall encompass key elements: artefact analysis including architecture review, error-handling and input validation, external interface and protocol assessment (including deprecation and encryption/integrity checks), additional security testing, documentation review, and risk treatment alignment verification. See guidance for these key elements.

title: A process shall be established for selecting, configuring, and maintaining stati…
text: A process shall be established for selecting, configuring, and maintaining static application security testing (SAST) tools and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools appropriate for the mobile platform(s) in scope (iOS, Android, or cross-platform), and the rationale for tool selection relative to the product's technology stack and cybersecurity requirements shall be documented.

title: Products shall undergo code review conducted by suitably qualified reviewers who…
text: Products shall undergo code review conducted by suitably qualified reviewers who are independent of the code's authors; the review scope shall encompass at least misuse patterns and all critical findings shall be remediated prior to release.

title: The V&V process shall document and identify all test methods and selected test t…
text: The V&V process shall document and identify all test methods and selected test tools for cybersecurity V&V activities, including the rationale for their selection relative to the product's risk profile and design, and any deviations from the planned test scope together with their justification.

title: Cybersecurity V&V activities shall recur throughout the product lifecycle in ali…
text: Cybersecurity V&V activities shall recur throughout the product lifecycle in alignment with the vulnerability management activities described in 6.9 and shall not be limited to final development stages. For this purpose, a documented schedule for recurring cybersecurity V&V activities shall be established that specifies, at minimum, the trigger conditions for re-testing (e.g., new release, significant code change, newly disclosed vulnerability affecting a component, change in threat landscape) and the V&V activities required for each trigger type.

title: A security test and review plan shall be developed that is grounded in the produ…
text: A security test and review plan shall be developed that is grounded in the product's context, its cybersecurity architecture and design, the defined cybersecurity requirements for the product, the results of the risk assessment, and the results of tests and reviews. The plan shall define what tests and reviews are to be performed, what methodologies to apply, how often, and at what intervals, calibrated to the risk profile associated with the product's intended use.

title: Software products and software updates that are distributed as software images o…
text: Software products and software updates that are distributed as software images or other distribution artefacts shall be protected against manipulation throughout the entire distribution lifecycle, covering both network transit and storage at rest. For this purpose, a documented build and release pipeline shall be maintained, including automated integrity controls and verification at defined points in the pipeline, including compilation, packaging, signing (conformant to 6.8-CR-05), and release or upload to the distribution channel.

title: Where justified by the product's risk assessment and cybersecurity context, the …
text: Where justified by the product's risk assessment and cybersecurity context, the production and distribution activities for digital software products shall incorporate access authentication.

title: Where applicable, user-facing information and instructions distributed digitally…
text: Where applicable, user-facing information and instructions distributed digitally shall be protected against manipulation or unauthorized disclosure during distribution, including protection of the communication channels through which they are delivered.

title: Where applicable, information and instructions intended for the user shall be de…
text: Where applicable, information and instructions intended for the user shall be delivered and presented in a manner that is accessible to the intended user population.

title: A code-signing process shall be established and maintained for mobile applicatio…
text: A code-signing process shall be established and maintained for mobile application distribution artefacts that defines: • the lifecycle management of signing credentials, including Android signing keys/keystores and iOS distribution certificates and provisioning profiles, as applicable; • the roles authorized to approve and perform signing operations; and • the conditions under which signing is permitted. Signing keys used for Android (keystore) or iOS (provisioning profiles and certificates) shall be stored in a secrets management system (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) and not in the repository.

title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access controls shall be enforc…
text: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access controls shall be enforced for all accounts with the ability to publish, update, or manage mobile application releases on distribution platforms (e.g. Google Play Console, Apple App Store Connect), and an access review process shall be maintained for these accounts.

title: The product shall be made identifiable by recording, at minimum, the manufacture…
text: The product shall be made identifiable by recording, at minimum, the manufacturer's name, the product name, and a version for recognizability and traceability to support for example vulnerability handling, down-stream software bill of materials (SBOM) generation and verification, and vulnerability information sharing and reporting.

title: A communication mechanism shall be provided through which security-related infor…
text: A communication mechanism shall be provided through which security-related information - including advisories, release notes, installation guidance, and notifications - is made available for the product.

title: Where the product type, connectivity, and operational context make it feasible, …
text: Where the product type, connectivity, and operational context make it feasible, a mechanism enabling security updates to be distributed automatically or semi-automatically shall be provided.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: Periodic procedures, automated where possible, shall be performed for monitoring…
text: Periodic procedures, automated where possible, shall be performed for monitoring of internal and external information that may affect the product's risk assessment as defined in 5.4 to 5.7, covering at least cybersecurity incidents and vulnerabilities, at intervals that are justifiable given the product context. Documentation shall include activities, frequency, sources, and the roles responsible for execution and review.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: The risks of verified cybersecurity incidents, changes in the threat landscape, …
text: The risks of verified cybersecurity incidents, changes in the threat landscape, and discovered vulnerabilities shall be assessed aligned with the risk assessment methodology established under 5.4 to 5.7.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: Upon discovery of a new vulnerability, documentation of that vulnerability shall…
text: Upon discovery of a new vulnerability, documentation of that vulnerability shall be produced and communicated to relevant parties where the risk assessment and cybersecurity context make such communication appropriate.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: Verified cybersecurity incidents and discovered vulnerabilities shall be treated…
text: Verified cybersecurity incidents and discovered vulnerabilities shall be treated in a timely manner, with the urgency and nature of treatment proportionate to the risk assessment outcome and the specific cybersecurity context of the product.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: Where cybersecurity incident or vulnerability have residual risk, that risk shal…
text: Where cybersecurity incident or vulnerability have residual risk, that risk shall be communicated to stakeholders using the communication processes and channels established under Clause 5.9, where relevant.

section: 5.9 Product Cybersecurity Monitoring and Issue Management
title: At a minimum, the following designated internal and external sources shall be dr…
text: At a minimum, the following designated internal and external sources shall be drawn upon when monitoring for vulnerabilities: the EU Vulnerability Database, externally reported vulnerabilities, outputs from regular testing, and regular review activities.

title: Secure decommissioning shall be prepared by identifying cybersecurity aspects of…
text: Secure decommissioning shall be prepared by identifying cybersecurity aspects of decommissioning, all confidential assets requiring deletion and their location, establishing appropriate actions for any third-party-operated components, defining the method of user communication and what that communication needs to include, and documenting all manufacturer-side activities required to achieve secure decommissioning.

title: Where user-facing decommissioning instructions are required, those instructions …
text: Where user-facing decommissioning instructions are required, those instructions shall address, as applicable: removal and export of user data, removal of security-relevant configuration data, disconnection from the operational environment, secure disposal of the product, and advance notice of any automated data deletion including its scope and timing.

title: Before selecting and integrating any third-party component into a product, due d…
text: Before selecting and integrating any third-party component into a product, due diligence shall be carried out on a number of aspects when applicable. This shall include verifying alignment of the component's intended purpose with its planned use in the product, confirming the absence of known vulnerabilities, and determining whether additional cybersecurity testing is needed. For commercial components, the availability of CE marking and an EU Declaration of Conformity shall be checked. For FOSS components, assessment shall be performed of maintenance activity, availability of a vulnerability disclosure process, stewardship by a recognized organization, evidence of cybersecurity-by-design practices, and availability of security updates. In addition, license obligations shall be identified, documented, and managed prior to integration and throughout the component lifecycle.

title: Both the third-party component itself and the manner in which it is integrated i…
text: Both the third-party component itself and the manner in which it is integrated into the product shall be addressed within the risk assessment and risk treatment activities required by Clause 5.

title: Third-party components and their integration into the product shall be included …
text: Third-party components and their integration into the product shall be included in verification and validation specified in clause 6.7.

title: Ongoing monitoring of third-party components shall be maintained for the duratio…
text: Ongoing monitoring of third-party components shall be maintained for the duration of the product's lifecycle, so that vulnerabilities relevant to the product can be identified, in line with the monitoring activities set out in clause 6.9. This is a continuous obligation and does not end once initial integration is complete.

title: Where a vulnerability is discovered in a commercial third-party component, the v…
text: Where a vulnerability is discovered in a commercial third-party component, the vulnerability shall be documented, disclosed to the responsible third-party, and remediated following the applicable vulnerability disclosure and handling procedures. The responsible third-party may be a supplier, service provider, or any party capable of facilitating handling of the vulnerability.

title: Where the manufacturer discovers a vulnerability in a FOSS component and develop…
text: Where the manufacturer discovers a vulnerability in a FOSS component and develops a fix, that fix shall be communicated to the open-source project concerned. Where it is possible to do so, the fix shall also be contributed upstream to the original project, under the terms of the applicable source code license.

title: Third-party component suppliers shall be assessed for maintenance activity (leve…
text: Third-party component suppliers shall be assessed for maintenance activity (level of support or having reached end-of-support) on an annual basis. A documented policy shall be established and maintained to define the maximum permissible period between the public disclosure of a vulnerability in a third-party component and the release of a remediated version or the implementation of an accepted compensating control, differentiated by vulnerability severity. If a supplier fails to meet the timeframe or support is below the documented threshold, a risk assessment shall be performed on the potential consequences of this support issue, which may lead to eventually deprecating the corresponding component(s).

title: Operational security measures shall be maintained across all activities involvin…
text: Operational security measures shall be maintained across all activities involving the receipt and communication of vulnerability information or reports.

title: Access to vulnerability information shall be restricted, when it has not yet bee…
text: Access to vulnerability information shall be restricted, when it has not yet been publicly disclosed, where applicable, to only those individuals who require it in order to fulfil their responsibilities within the vulnerability handling process.

title: A vulnerability handling policy shall be established, implemented, and followed.
text: A vulnerability handling policy shall be established, implemented, and followed.

title: The vulnerability handling policy shall describe the organization’s overall dire…
text: The vulnerability handling policy shall describe the organization’s overall direction, principles, and responsibilities for handling potential vulnerabilities in products; set out how information about those vulnerabilities will be safeguarded against disclosure before remediation is available; establish a planned timeframe for remediation development; and explain the approach to the regular testing and review activities defined in 6.7.

title: Continuous monitoring shall be in place whether the vulnerability handling proce…
text: Continuous monitoring shall be in place whether the vulnerability handling process is operating effectively.

title: The vulnerability handling policy shall support all activities defined in the vu…
text: The vulnerability handling policy shall support all activities defined in the vulnerability disclosure policy described in 7.3

title: A documented process shall be established for evaluating, approving, and recordi…
text: A documented process shall be established for evaluating, approving, and recording decisions to delay full vulnerability publication under the conditions specified in 7.7-CR-05, including defined criteria for the risk evaluation, designated approval authority, maximum permissible delay duration, and a procedure for communicating the disclosure date to affected users of the mobile application.

title: A coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy shall be established, implemented,…
text: A coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy shall be established, implemented, followed, and made publicly available in an accessible form

title: The CVD policy shall include contact mechanisms accessible through multiple sens…
text: The CVD policy shall include contact mechanisms accessible through multiple sensory modalities, ensuring users with diverse impairments are not excluded.

title: The CVD policy shall explicitly set out what parties can expect with respect to …
text: The CVD policy shall explicitly set out what parties can expect with respect to ongoing communication throughout the vulnerability disclosure process.

title: The CVD policy shall address each of the following areas: the expected contents …
text: The CVD policy shall address each of the following areas: the expected contents of a vulnerability report; options for secure communication; the scope of the program; publication arrangements; and recognition of reporters.

title: A disclosure process shall be established so that details about a vulnerability …
text: A disclosure process shall be established so that details about a vulnerability are not made public until the vulnerability has been remediated.

title: Secure communication mechanisms for vulnerability disclosure shall be made known…
text: Secure communication mechanisms for vulnerability disclosure shall be made known to reporters and stakeholders.

title: The vulnerability reporting process shall include an option that allows reporter…
text: The vulnerability reporting process shall include an option that allows reporters to submit information without disclosing their identity.

title: Security controls applied to communication channels shall not create unreasonabl…
text: Security controls applied to communication channels shall not create unreasonable barriers that prevent external parties from contacting the organization.

title: A public reporting channel shall be made available, using the accessible methods…
text: A public reporting channel shall be made available, using the accessible methods specified in 7.3-CR-02, so that vulnerability information or reports can be received.

title: A system for assigning and maintaining identifiers or tracking numbers to report…
text: A system for assigning and maintaining identifiers or tracking numbers to reported vulnerabilities shall be implemented to support ongoing traceability of each report.

title: Receipt shall be confirmed of a potential vulnerability report to the reporter w…
text: Receipt shall be confirmed of a potential vulnerability report to the reporter within a response window that is defined and published as part of the coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.

title: Vulnerability reports submitted through channels that do not meet the security s…
text: Vulnerability reports submitted through channels that do not meet the security standards described in 7.1 should still be accepted rather than rejected on the basis of the submission method alone.

title: Where a vulnerability report does not contain enough detail to support assessmen…
text: Where a vulnerability report does not contain enough detail to support assessment, the necessary additional information shall be requested from the reporter.

title: A structured triage of each reported vulnerability shall be performed.
text: A structured triage of each reported vulnerability shall be performed.

title: Risk resulting from the vulnerability shall be evaluated aligned with the method…
text: Risk resulting from the vulnerability shall be evaluated aligned with the methodology specified in 5.4 to 5.7.

title: Each vulnerability shall be assigned a handling priority, derived from both the …
text: Each vulnerability shall be assigned a handling priority, derived from both the risk evaluation result and the risk profile specific to the product.

title: If the assessed risk level of a vulnerability surpasses the manufacturer's defin…
text: If the assessed risk level of a vulnerability surpasses the manufacturer's defined risk threshold, the vulnerability resolution process shall be expedited.

title: When a vulnerability has been reported through a coordinated disclosure process,…
text: When a vulnerability has been reported through a coordinated disclosure process, the originating reporter shall be notified of the outcome of the intake activity, if possible.

section: 6.5 Communication with Stakeholders in Vulnerability Handling
title: Communication with reporters and all relevant stakeholders shall be initiated an…
text: Communication with reporters and all relevant stakeholders shall be initiated and sustained throughout the vulnerability handling process.

section: 6.5 Communication with Stakeholders in Vulnerability Handling
title: When communicating with users, communication channels and formats shall be emplo…
text: When communicating with users, communication channels and formats shall be employed that are accessible to a broad range of users.

title: A formal remediation decision shall be made and documented for each identified v…
text: A formal remediation decision shall be made and documented for each identified vulnerability, determining the course of action to address it.

title: Following the remediation decision, a concrete action plan shall be established …
text: Following the remediation decision, a concrete action plan shall be established that specifies what steps will be taken and sets a defined timeline for their completion.

title: Once a decision to remediate a vulnerability has been made, the necessary activi…
text: Once a decision to remediate a vulnerability has been made, the necessary activities shall be carried out to produce that remediation.

title: Where it is technically feasible to do so, security updates shall be delivered i…
text: Where it is technically feasible to do so, security updates shall be delivered independently of functional updates, rather than bundled together.

title: Any remediation applied to address a vulnerability shall undergo testing to conf…
text: Any remediation applied to address a vulnerability shall undergo testing to confirm that the associated risk has been adequately reduced and that no unacceptable adverse effects on the product or its users have been introduced.

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: Security updates shall be made available at no cost, except where a manufacturer…
text: Security updates shall be made available at no cost, except where a manufacturer and a business user have explicitly agreed otherwise for a purpose-built product with digital elements.

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: After a security update has been made ready, it shall be released to users witho…
text: After a security update has been made ready, it shall be released to users without undue delay.

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: Where the delivery of a security update is not entirely automated, clear install…
text: Where the delivery of a security update is not entirely automated, clear installation instructions shall be supplied to users.

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: After a vulnerability has been resolved, information shall be provisioned in lin…
text: After a vulnerability has been resolved, information shall be provisioned in line with the coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) policy established under 7.3; where suitable, such information may be presented in summarized or aggregated form, in a format readable by humans, in a widely recognized machine-readable format, and include, as a minimum, the following elements to allow recipients to assess relevance and take appropriate remediation action: • a description of the vulnerability • a vulnerability identifier • information sufficient to identify the affected product • the potential impact of the vulnerability • the severity of the vulnerability • detailed remediation instructions • the date of release and any subsequent update date

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: Complete publication of vulnerability information shall be deferred in order to …
text: Complete publication of vulnerability information shall be deferred in order to allow adequate time for security update distribution, in case all three of the following conditions are simultaneously satisfied: • the risks associated with full disclosure outweigh its security benefits at that time. • Sufficient information about the resolved vulnerability is made available to users in a manner that does not enable an attacker to exploit it. • Users are notified of the scheduled date on which all vulnerability information will be publicly disclosed.

section: 6.7 Release of Security Updates and Information in Vulnerability Handling
title: Following the release of a remediation, post-release activities shall be execute…
text: Following the release of a remediation, post-release activities shall be executed that encompass maintaining the vulnerability case record and tracking the effectiveness of the applied remediation.

title: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID to a Wallet Unit that already holds an ac…
text: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID to a Wallet Unit that already holds an active Logical PID issued by that PID Provider.

title: The PID Provider shall cancel a PID that has been generated but not issued withi…
text: The PID Provider shall cancel a PID that has been generated but not issued within the maximum retention period defined in its documented issuance procedures, together with the personal data associated with that PID.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where a PID is generated in advance of issuance, the PID Provider …
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where a PID is generated in advance of issuance, the PID Provider shall re-verify, immediately before issuance, that no ground preventing issuance has arisen since the PID was generated, including loss of eligibility, a change in the attributes held by the authoritative population register, decease, a fraud signal, or the identity document having been reported lost or stolen.

title: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID to a Wallet Unit of a Wallet Provider whi…
text: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID to a Wallet Unit of a Wallet Provider while an active Logical PID issued by that PID Provider in the name of the same person is held in another Wallet Unit of that same Wallet Provider, unless the Technical PIDs of that Logical PID have been revoked in accordance with ISS-5.1-05.

title: The PID Provider shall revoke the Technical PIDs referred to in ISS-5.1-04 only …
text: The PID Provider shall revoke the Technical PIDs referred to in ISS-5.1-04 only after all other conditions for issuing the further PID have been met, including the confirmation required by ISS-5.4-04 where that requirement applies.

title: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing a PID, that the Wallet Unit presen…
text: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing a PID, that the Wallet Unit presents a Wallet Instance Attestation that is valid, has not expired, and has not been revoked.

title: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing a PID, that the issuer of the Wall…
text: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing a PID, that the issuer of the Wallet Instance Attestation is present in the applicable trusted list.

title: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID unless the Wallet Unit has provided the W…
text: The PID Provider shall not issue a PID unless the Wallet Unit has provided the Wallet Trust Evidence required to establish that its cryptographic device satisfies the conditions for Assurance Level High.

title: The PID Provider shall not bind a PID to a public key unless it has verified pro…
text: The PID Provider shall not bind a PID to a public key unless it has verified proof of possession of the corresponding private key as specified in CRED-REQ-PROC-4.6.2.1-0 of [5].

title: The PID Provider shall verify, using the key provenance attestation provided dur…
text: The PID Provider shall verify, using the key provenance attestation provided during issuance, that the PID binding key pair is generated and held in a cryptographic device certified at a level appropriate for Assurance Level High.

title: The PID Provider shall not rely on trusted-list data whose current validity cann…
text: The PID Provider shall not rely on trusted-list data whose current validity cannot be confirmed when validating the Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall verify that the unique identifier established for the sub…
text: The PID Provider shall verify that the unique identifier established for the subject during identity proofing corresponds to the identity that was authenticated in the same identity-proofing session.

title: The PID Provider shall not introduce, into the PID or into the data it generates…
text: The PID Provider shall not introduce, into the PID or into the data it generates during issuance, any identifier or reused value - other than the PID attributes themselves - that would enable a third party to correlate separate Technical PIDs or issuance events independently of the attributes disclosed under the User's control from PID representations.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall verify, during identity proofing, that the presented identity document chip is genuine and has not been cloned, using the chip's active authentication mechanism or an equivalent anti-cloning mechanism.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall accept the identity document only if validation of the issuer signature on the chip data against the country signing public key infrastructure returns a complete, fully-passed result.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall establish that the identity document chip is read live during the identity-proofing session.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall not accept a previously captured or stored chip readout in place of a live read of the identity document.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document and a status service for that identity document is available, the PID Provider shall check the status of the presented identity document before completing identity proofing.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall not complete identity proofing where the status check, or any other information available to it, indicates that the identity document is reported lost, stolen, or revoked.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall complete identity proofing only after the chip of the identity document has confirmed successful verification of the document PIN.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall protect the exchange in which the identity document is electronically authenticated against interception and modification by a party interposed between the identity document and the PID Provider.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall record the number of failed PACE or PINverification attempts that occurred, within the same identity-proofing session, before a successful attempt.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, an identity-proofing session in which the number of failed PACE or PIN-verification attempts before a successful attempt exceeds a defined threshold.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall record the identity document's chip identifier together with the national identification number established during each identity-proofing session.

section: 5.3.2 Identity Proofing Using a Digital Identity Document
title: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digi…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the PID Provider performs the identity proofing based on a digital identity document, the PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, an identity document chip identifier that has been recorded together with more than one distinct national identification number.

title: The PID Provider shall reject an issuance request that does not contain a valid,…
text: The PID Provider shall reject an issuance request that does not contain a valid, unused freshness value bound to the authenticated wallet session.

title: The PID Provider shall not authorise issuance unless every required precondition…
text: The PID Provider shall not authorise issuance unless every required precondition has been successfully completed, comprising Wallet Unit trust verification, user identity verification, and the eligibility check.

title: The PID Provider shall log an issuance request rejected for failing a freshness …
text: The PID Provider shall log an issuance request rejected for failing a freshness or replay check, together with the reason for rejection.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where one or more contact methods are registered for a person, the…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where one or more contact methods are registered for a person, the PID Provider shall not authorise the issuance of a PID in that person's name to a Wallet Unit that does not yet hold a Logical PID of that person unless the person has entered in the issuance flow the one-time code that the PID Provider has sent through a registered contact method.

title: The PID Provider shall ensure that every message that carries a one-time code un…
text: The PID Provider shall ensure that every message that carries a one-time code under ISS-5.4-04 names the Wallet Provider of the Wallet Unit concerned, states that a new Wallet Unit is being set up in the person's name, warns the person never to share the code with anyone, and contains no link, QR code, or telephone number to call.

title: The PID Provider shall invalidate a one-time code issued under ISS-5.4-04 or ISS…
text: The PID Provider shall invalidate a one-time code issued under ISS-5.4-04 or ISS-5.7-21 after its first successful use, after the end of a defined validity period, and after a defined number of failed entry attempts.

title: The PID Provider shall not generate a PID unless a complete and current set of t…
text: The PID Provider shall not generate a PID unless a complete and current set of the required attributes has been obtained from the authoritative population register.

title: The PID Provider shall populate each mandatory PID attribute in accordance with …
text: The PID Provider shall populate each mandatory PID attribute in accordance with the applicable national value convention, including the defined fall-back values where an attribute value is not available.

title: The PID Provider shall not fetch, process, or store any optional attribute that …
text: The PID Provider shall not fetch, process, or store any optional attribute that has been excluded at national level.

title: The PID Provider shall bind the PID to the dedicated PID binding public key prov…
text: The PID Provider shall bind the PID to the dedicated PID binding public key provided for that PID and to no other key.

title: The PID Provider shall sign the PID using a signing key whose certificate chains…
text: The PID Provider shall sign the PID using a signing key whose certificate chains to a trust anchor published in the applicable trusted list.

title: The PID Provider shall use the PID signing key only within the authorised issuan…
text: The PID Provider shall use the PID signing key only within the authorised issuance process.

title: The PID Provider shall set the validity period of the PID so that it does not ex…
text: The PID Provider shall set the validity period of the PID so that it does not exceed the maximum PID lifetime defined by national policy.

title: The PID Provider shall set the validity period of the PID so that it does not ex…
text: The PID Provider shall set the validity period of the PID so that it does not extend beyond the validity of the Wallet Unit to which the PID is issued.

title: The PID Provider shall not release a PID to the Wallet Unit before authenticatio…
text: The PID Provider shall not release a PID to the Wallet Unit before authentication of the Wallet Unit and of the holder has completed successfully.

title: The PID Provider shall deliver the PID to the Wallet Unit using the issuance pro…
text: The PID Provider shall deliver the PID to the Wallet Unit using the issuance protocol specified in [5].

title: The PID Provider shall record the outcome of each issuance, including any refusa…
text: The PID Provider shall record the outcome of each issuance, including any refusal of the issued PID by the Wallet Unit and any case where the Wallet Unit does not respond.

title: The PID Provider shall classify a PID that has left its systems as issued, regar…
text: The PID Provider shall classify a PID that has left its systems as issued, regardless of whether the Wallet Unit confirms its acceptance.

title: The PID Provider shall revoke a PID that it has classified as issued where the W…
text: The PID Provider shall revoke a PID that it has classified as issued where the Wallet Unit reports that the PID was not accepted.

title: The PID Provider shall register each issued PID, including its identifier, its v…
text: The PID Provider shall register each issued PID, including its identifier, its validity end date, and its status, in the PID Provider's administration and status service.

title: The PID Provider shall record, for each issued PID, the Wallet Unit to which tha…
text: The PID Provider shall record, for each issued PID, the Wallet Unit to which that PID was issued.

title: The PID Provider shall record the withdrawal of a PID that has already been deli…
text: The PID Provider shall record the withdrawal of a PID that has already been delivered to a Wallet Unit as a revocation with a corresponding entry in the status service.

title: The PID Provider shall record each issuance event in a tamper-evident log with s…
text: The PID Provider shall record each issuance event in a tamper-evident log with sufficient detail to support conformity assessment and incident investigation.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the person identified in the PID, through a channe…
text: The PID Provider shall notify the person identified in the PID, through a channel independent of the Wallet Unit, when a PID is issued in that person's name.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the person in whose name a PID was requested, thro…
text: The PID Provider shall notify the person in whose name a PID was requested, through a channel independent of the Wallet Unit, when a request to issue a PID in that person's name does not result in issuance because identity proofing or another eligibility check failed, inviting that person to raise an alarm if they did not make the request.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the identified person, through a channel independe…
text: The PID Provider shall notify the identified person, through a channel independent of the Wallet Unit, when more than one Logical PID issued by that PID Provider is active in that person's name.

title: The PID Provider shall offer the person the opportunity to register one or more …
text: The PID Provider shall offer the person the opportunity to register one or more contact methods that are capable of delivering a notification to the person without delay.

title: The PID Provider shall ensure that the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06 st…
text: The PID Provider shall ensure that the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06 states explicitly that the activation of a further Wallet Unit that the person did not perform or authorise or that was done on request of someone else, may result in financial loss or identity theft to that person.

title: The PID Provider shall include, in the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06, a…
text: The PID Provider shall include, in the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06, a means for the person to revoke the newly issued PID through a low-threshold procedure.

title: The PID Provider shall require the use of its standard revocation procedure to r…
text: The PID Provider shall require the use of its standard revocation procedure to revoke any PID, other than the newly issued PID referred to in ISS-5.7-09, that is active in that person's name.

title: The PID Provider shall record, for each national identification number, the numb…
text: The PID Provider shall record, for each national identification number, the number of Wallet Units to which a PID for that national identification number is currently issued and within its Administrative Validity Period, and the timestamps of each issuance and renewal request relating to that national identification number.

title: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a national identification number…
text: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a national identification number whose active-Logical-PID count or issuance-or-renewal-request rate exceeds a defined threshold.

title: The PID Provider shall record, where available to it, the network origin or loca…
text: The PID Provider shall record, where available to it, the network origin or locality indicator of each issuance or renewal request.

title: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, two issuance or renewal requests…
text: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, two issuance or renewal requests relating to the same national identification number whose recorded network origin or locality indicators are inconsistent with the time elapsed between them.

title: The PID Provider shall subject each case that this specification requires to be …
text: The PID Provider shall subject each case that this specification requires to be flagged for investigation to a defined investigation and response procedure.

title: The PID Provider shall record, for each issued PID, the Wallet Provider that pro…
text: The PID Provider shall record, for each issued PID, the Wallet Provider that provided the Wallet Unit to which the PID was issued and the date of issuance.

title: The PID Provider shall state, in each notification referred to in ISS-5.7-05 and…
text: The PID Provider shall state, in each notification referred to in ISS-5.7-05 and ISS-5.7-06, the Wallet Provider and the date of issuance recorded under ISS-5.7-16 for the Wallet Unit concerned.

title: The PID Provider shall list, in the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06, ever…
text: The PID Provider shall list, in the notification referred to in ISS-5.7-06, every Wallet Unit in which an active Logical PID is held in the person's name, stating for each the Wallet Provider and the date of issuance, and invite the person to revoke any Wallet Unit that is suspicious or no longer in use through the standard revocation procedure referred to in ISS-5.7-10.

title: The PID Provider shall not disclose to a Wallet Unit, or offer through a Wallet …
text: The PID Provider shall not disclose to a Wallet Unit, or offer through a Wallet Unit a means to revoke, any other Wallet Unit in which a PID is held in the name of the same person.

title: The PID Provider shall, at the first issuance of a PID in a person's name, colle…
text: The PID Provider shall, at the first issuance of a PID in a person's name, collect from the person both a mobile telephone number that is able to receive text messages and an e-mail address, and register them as contact methods under ISS-5.7-07 unless the person explicitly declines.

title: The PID Provider shall register a contact method only after the person has enter…
text: The PID Provider shall register a contact method only after the person has entered a one-time code that the PID Provider has sent to that contact method.

title: The PID Provider shall replace a registered contact method only after the person…
text: The PID Provider shall replace a registered contact method only after the person has entered a one-time code that the PID Provider has sent to the contact method that is being replaced, except where ISS-5.7-24 applies.

title: The PID Provider shall notify every contact method registered before a change, t…
text: The PID Provider shall notify every contact method registered before a change, through that contact method, when a registered contact method has been replaced.

title: The PID Provider shall, where the person has no access to a contact method that …
text: The PID Provider shall, where the person has no access to a contact method that is to be replaced, replace it only after identity proofing in accordance with clause 4.3, at the same assurance level as required for initial issuance, has been completed for that person.

title: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a network origin indicator recor…
text: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a network origin indicator recorded under ISS-5.7-13 that is linked to issuance or renewal requests for more than a defined number of distinct national identification numbers within a defined period.

title: The PID Provider shall limit the retention of the network origin indicators reco…
text: The PID Provider shall limit the retention of the network origin indicators recorded under ISS-5.7-13 to a period determined as part of its risk assessment.

title: The PID Provider shall use the network origin indicators recorded under ISS5.7-1…
text: The PID Provider shall use the network origin indicators recorded under ISS5.7-13 for no purpose other than the detection of fraud.

title: ISS-4.4-01 applies in this context as well.
text: ISS-4.4-01 applies in this context as well.

title: The PID Provider shall not replenish Technical PIDs to a Wallet Unit for which t…
text: The PID Provider shall not replenish Technical PIDs to a Wallet Unit for which the Administrative Validity Period has ended.

title: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing replenished Technical PIDs, that t…
text: The PID Provider shall verify, before issuing replenished Technical PIDs, that the attribute values of the Logical PID remain current.

title: The PID Provider shall revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs of a Logical PID wh…
text: The PID Provider shall revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs of a Logical PID when a revocation condition for that Logical PID is established.

title: The PID Provider shall not continue automatic replenishment to a Wallet Unit for…
text: The PID Provider shall not continue automatic replenishment to a Wallet Unit for which it has received an indication that the Wallet Unit or its device is no longer under the legitimate user's control.

title: The PID Provider shall not treat an indication that a Wallet Unit or its device …
text: The PID Provider shall not treat an indication that a Wallet Unit or its device is no longer under the legitimate user's control as qualifying under REP-5.1-05 unless the reliability of that indication has been established through a defined verification procedure.

title: The PID Provider shall record the timestamp and the Technical-PID count of each …
text: The PID Provider shall record the timestamp and the Technical-PID count of each batch replenishment performed for a Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, a maximum batc…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, a maximum batch size and a maximum number of outstanding Technical PIDs per Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall not exceed the maximum batch size or the maximum number o…
text: The PID Provider shall not exceed the maximum batch size or the maximum number of outstanding Technical PIDs per Wallet Unit, determined under REP-5.1-08, when replenishing a Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall, when it establishes that the attribute values held for a…
text: The PID Provider shall, when it establishes that the attribute values held for a person by the Authentic Source have changed from those carried by the outstanding Technical PIDs of the Logical PID, revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs that carry the superseded values.

title: The PID Provider shall, when it establishes that the attribute values held for a…
text: The PID Provider shall, when it establishes that the attribute values held for a person by the Authentic Source have changed from those carried by the outstanding Technical PIDs of the Logical PID, henceforth issue new Technical PIDs carrying the updated attribute values.

title: ISS-4.6-02 applies also in the context of replenishment.
text: ISS-4.6-02 applies also in the context of replenishment.

title: The PID Provider shall verify the authenticity and integrity of the refresh toke…
text: The PID Provider shall verify the authenticity and integrity of the refresh token presented in a replenishment request.

title: The PID Provider shall verify that the refresh token is cryptographically bound …
text: The PID Provider shall verify that the refresh token is cryptographically bound to the Wallet Unit that holds the Logical PID to be replenished.

title: The PID Provider shall reject a replenishment request whose refresh token is exp…
text: The PID Provider shall reject a replenishment request whose refresh token is expired or has been revoked.

title: ISS-4.2-04 applies also in the context of replenishment.
text: ISS-4.2-04 applies also in the context of replenishment.

title: The PID Provider shall verify, using the key provenance attestation provided for…
text: The PID Provider shall verify, using the key provenance attestation provided for a batch of replenished Technical PIDs, that the PID binding key pair of every Technical PID in that batch is generated and held in a cryptographic device certified at a level appropriate for Assurance Level High.

title: ISS-4.5-05 applies also in the context of replenishment.
text: ISS-4.5-05 applies also in the context of replenishment.

title: The PID Provider shall issue each replenished Technical PID as a credential that…
text: The PID Provider shall issue each replenished Technical PID as a credential that is distinct from every other Technical PID of the same Logical PID.

title: The PID Provider shall not release a replenished Technical PID to the Wallet Uni…
text: The PID Provider shall not release a replenished Technical PID to the Wallet Unit before verification of the refresh token and validation of the Wallet Unit have completed successfully.

title: The PID Provider shall deliver each replenished Technical PID to the Wallet Unit…
text: The PID Provider shall deliver each replenished Technical PID to the Wallet Unit over a channel that provides confidentiality, integrity, and endpoint authentication bound to the authenticated Wallet Unit.

title: ISS-4.7-01 applies also in the context of replenishment.
text: ISS-4.7-01 applies also in the context of replenishment.

text: ISS-4.7-04 applies also in the context of replenishment.

title: The PID Provider shall protect any exchange with the authentic source performed …
text: The PID Provider shall protect any exchange with the authentic source performed during replenishment against interception and modification.

title: The PID Provider shall mark a Technical PID as expired or inactive in its admini…
text: The PID Provider shall mark a Technical PID as expired or inactive in its administration once its technical validity period has ended or the Wallet Unit has reported that it was not accepted.

title: The PID Provider shall retain the audit log entries relating to a Technical PID …
text: The PID Provider shall retain the audit log entries relating to a Technical PID for the defined retention period, including after that Technical PID has been marked as inactive in the PID Provider's administration.

title: The PID Provider shall determine the retention period referred to in REP-5.4-02 …
text: The PID Provider shall determine the retention period referred to in REP-5.4-02 as part of its risk assessment.

title: The PID Provider shall not perform Batch Replenishment of a Logical PID after it…
text: The PID Provider shall not perform Batch Replenishment of a Logical PID after its Administrative Validity Period has ended without Renewal.

title: The PID Provider shall record the timestamp of each renewal request together wit…
text: The PID Provider shall record the timestamp of each renewal request together with the outcome of the re-identification performed for that request.

title: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a Logical PID whose renewal requ…
text: The PID Provider shall flag, for investigation, a Logical PID whose renewal requests show a frequency or a pattern relative to re-identification outcomes that exceeds a defined threshold.

title: The PID Provider shall verify the identity of the person to whom the Logical PID…
text: The PID Provider shall verify the identity of the person to whom the Logical PID was issued, applying the identity-proofing requirements of clause 4.3 at the same assurance level required for initial issuance, before renewing that Logical PID.

title: ISS-4.4-01 applies also in the context of renewal.
text: ISS-4.4-01 applies also in the context of renewal.

title: The PID Provider shall not authorise a renewal unless the person's identity has …
text: The PID Provider shall not authorise a renewal unless the person's identity has been verified, no ground precluding renewal is present, and the request has been shown to originate from the Wallet Unit holding the Logical PID to be renewed.

title: The PID Provider shall verify that a renewal request is bound to the Logical PID…
text: The PID Provider shall verify that a renewal request is bound to the Logical PID to be renewed by requiring proof of possession of the private key corresponding to the existing PID binding public key of that Logical PID.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the identified person, over a channel that ensures…
text: The PID Provider shall notify the identified person, over a channel that ensures the integrity and authenticity of the notification and is independent of the Wallet Unit, when their Logical PID has been renewed.

title: ISS-4.7-04 applies also in the context of renewal.
text: ISS-4.7-04 applies also in the context of renewal.

title: When the PID Provider learns, from a reliable source, that the Wallet Unit to wh…
text: When the PID Provider learns, from a reliable source, that the Wallet Unit to which it has issued Technical PIDs, or the device hosting that Wallet Unit, is no longer under the legitimate user's control, the PID Provider shall revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs it has issued to that Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs it has issued to a …
text: The PID Provider shall revoke the outstanding Technical PIDs it has issued to a Wallet Unit when a revocation condition applies, including loss of eligibility of the subject, the decease of the subject, confirmed fraud, or a substantiated request from the legitimate user.

title: The PID Provider shall not treat an indication that a revocation condition appli…
text: The PID Provider shall not treat an indication that a revocation condition applies as a ground for revocation unless the reliability of that indication has been established through a defined verification procedure.

title: When a revocation condition for a Logical PID is established, the PID Provider s…
text: When a revocation condition for a Logical PID is established, the PID Provider shall revoke every outstanding Technical PID of that Logical PID that it has issued to the Wallet Unit, including Technical PIDs issued through batch replenishment.

title: The PID Provider shall revoke every outstanding Technical PID it has issued to a…
text: The PID Provider shall revoke every outstanding Technical PID it has issued to a Wallet Unit when that Wallet Unit is revoked.

title: The PID Provider shall end the Administrative Validity Period of a Logical PID i…
text: The PID Provider shall end the Administrative Validity Period of a Logical PID issued to a Wallet Unit when it revokes the Technical PIDs of that Logical PID.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the authentic source provides event-driven notification of t…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the authentic source provides event-driven notification of the decease of a person or of a loss of eligibility of a person, the PID Provider shall subscribe to that notification for each person in whose name a Logical PID is active and treat a received notification as an indication that a revocation condition applies under REV-4.103.

title: The PID Provider shall, when the decease of a person has been established as a r…
text: The PID Provider shall, when the decease of a person has been established as a revocation condition, notify every Wallet Provider that provided a Wallet Unit to which a PID of that person was issued, so that each of them is able to revoke the Wallet Unit concerned.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum ti…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum time within which the Technical PIDs are revoked after a revocation condition has been established.

title: The maximum time determined under REV-4.2-01 shall not exceed the maximum time f…
text: The maximum time determined under REV-4.2-01 shall not exceed the maximum time for revoking an electronic attestation of attributes set out in ETSI TS 119 471 [7], clause 4.2.5.1.

title: The PID Provider shall complete the revocation of the Technical PIDs within the …
text: The PID Provider shall complete the revocation of the Technical PIDs within the maximum time it has determined under REV-4.2-01.

title: The PID Provider shall record, for each revocation, the identity of the revoked …
text: The PID Provider shall record, for each revocation, the identity of the revoked Technical PIDs, the revocation condition, the outcome of its verification, and the time of revocation.

title: The PID Provider shall not reinstate a Technical PID once it has been revoked.
text: The PID Provider shall not reinstate a Technical PID once it has been revoked.

title: The PID Provider shall periodically verify the validity status of each Wallet Un…
text: The PID Provider shall periodically verify the validity status of each Wallet Unit to which it has issued Technical PIDs that have not reached a terminal state.

title: The PID Provider shall determine the interval of the verification under REV4.2-0…
text: The PID Provider shall determine the interval of the verification under REV4.2-06 as part of its risk assessment.

title: The PID Provider shall provide the person, after authentication at assurance lev…
text: The PID Provider shall provide the person, after authentication at assurance level substantial or high as defined in [2] and through a means that is not a Wallet Unit, with an overview of every Wallet Unit to which a PID in that person's name has been issued, stating for each the Wallet Provider, the date of issuance and the status.

title: The PID Provider shall, on a request made by the person in the overview referred…
text: The PID Provider shall, on a request made by the person in the overview referred to in REV-5.2-08, revoke the Technical PIDs issued to the Wallet Unit concerned in accordance with REV-4.1-05.
