title: The PID Provider shall forward a request under REV-5.2-09 to the Wallet Provider…
text: The PID Provider shall forward a request under REV-5.2-09 to the Wallet Provider that provided the Wallet Unit concerned, so that the Wallet Provider revokes the Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall provide a reporting point through which a person reports …
text: The PID Provider shall provide a reporting point through which a person reports the loss, theft or compromise of a Wallet Unit without authenticating through any Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall forward a report received under REV-5.2-11 to every Walle…
text: The PID Provider shall forward a report received under REV-5.2-11 to every Wallet Provider that provided a Wallet Unit to which a PID of the reporting person was issued.

title: The PID Provider shall verify, before acting on a report under REV-5.2-11 or on …
text: The PID Provider shall verify, before acting on a report under REV-5.2-11 or on a request under REV-5.2-09, that the person making it is the person in whose name the PIDs were issued, by a means that does not depend on a Wallet Unit.

title: The PID Provider shall ensure that a revocation initiated by an employee of the …
text: The PID Provider shall ensure that a revocation initiated by an employee of the PID Provider takes effect only after a second employee has approved it, and that both approvals are recorded in a tamper-evident log.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum ti…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum time within which the second approval under REV-5.2-14 is given.

title: The PID Provider shall ensure that the second approval under REV-5.2-14 is given…
text: The PID Provider shall ensure that the second approval under REV-5.2-14 is given within the maximum time determined under REV-5.2-15.

title: The PID Provider shall include in each Technical PID the reference to the status…
text: The PID Provider shall include in each Technical PID the reference to the status mechanism through which the revocation status of that Technical PID is made available, as required by ETSI TS 119 471 [7] and the attestation format profile ETSI TS 119 472-1 [8].

title: The PID Provider shall include in each Technical PID the identifier or index tha…
text: The PID Provider shall include in each Technical PID the identifier or index that distinguishes that Technical PID within its status mechanism, as required by ETSI TS 119 471 [7].

title: The PID Provider shall set the revocation status of a Technical PID in its statu…
text: The PID Provider shall set the revocation status of a Technical PID in its status mechanism to revoked when that Technical PID is revoked.

title: The PID Provider need not maintain revocation-status information for a Technical…
text: The PID Provider need not maintain revocation-status information for a Technical PID whose validity period is less than 24 hours, provided that this is stated in its PID provision policy.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum de…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum delay between the revocation of a Technical PID and the availability of its revoked status in the status mechanism.

title: The maximum delay determined under REV-4.3-05 shall not cause the revoked status…
text: The maximum delay determined under REV-4.3-05 shall not cause the revoked status of a Technical PID to become available later than the maximum time for revoking and publishing the status of an electronic attestation of attributes set out in ETSI TS 119 471 [7], clause 4.2.5.1.

title: The PID Provider shall make the revoked status of a Technical PID available in t…
text: The PID Provider shall make the revoked status of a Technical PID available in the status mechanism within the maximum delay it has determined under REV-4.3-05.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the Wallet User when the Technical PIDs issued to …
text: The PID Provider shall notify the Wallet User when the Technical PIDs issued to that Wallet User's Wallet Unit are revoked.

title: The PID Provider shall deliver the revocation notification to the Wallet User th…
text: The PID Provider shall deliver the revocation notification to the Wallet User through the government electronic mailbox (MijnOverheid Berichtenbox).

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum ti…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum time within which the Wallet User is notified after the Technical PIDs issued to that user's Wallet Unit are revoked.

title: The revocation notification shall identify the revoked PID and state that it can…
text: The revocation notification shall identify the revoked PID and state that it can no longer be used.

title: The PID Provider shall send the revocation notification referred to in REV-4.401…
text: The PID Provider shall send the revocation notification referred to in REV-4.401, in addition to the government electronic mailbox, through a contact method registered by the person with the PID Provider.

title: The PID Provider shall state in the revocation notification the Wallet Provider …
text: The PID Provider shall state in the revocation notification the Wallet Provider and the date of issuance of the Wallet Unit to which the revoked PIDs were issued.

title: The PID Provider shall detect, in its administration, when the validity period o…
text: The PID Provider shall detect, in its administration, when the validity period of a Technical PID has ended.

title: The PID Provider shall cease to treat a Technical PID as valid in its administra…
text: The PID Provider shall cease to treat a Technical PID as valid in its administration once the validity period of that Technical PID has ended.

title: The PID Provider shall notify the Wallet User when the Administrative Validity P…
text: The PID Provider shall notify the Wallet User when the Administrative Validity Period of a Logical PID issued to that Wallet User's Wallet Unit is approaching its end.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, how far in adv…
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, how far in advance of the end of the Administrative Validity Period the notification under EXP-5.1-03 is sent.

title: The PID Provider shall not revoke a Technical PID solely because its validity pe…
text: The PID Provider shall not revoke a Technical PID solely because its validity period has ended.

title: The PID Provider need not maintain revocation-status information for a Technical…
text: The PID Provider need not maintain revocation-status information for a Technical PID after its validity period has ended.

title: The PID Provider shall retain, after the expiry of a Technical PID, only the per…
text: The PID Provider shall retain, after the expiry of a Technical PID, only the personal data and records that remain necessary for status publication, audit, or legal obligations.

title: The PID Provider shall remove expired Technical PIDs from its administration in …
text: The PID Provider shall remove expired Technical PIDs from its administration in accordance with a defined cleanup procedure.

title: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the retention …
text: The PID Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the retention period after which expired Technical PID records are removed.

title: The PID Provider shall not remove records that are required for audit or statusp…
text: The PID Provider shall not remove records that are required for audit or statuspublication purposes before the end of their retention period.

title: The Wallet Unit shall allow the Wallet User to delete a PID it holds, on the use…
text: The Wallet Unit shall allow the Wallet User to delete a PID it holds, on the user's own initiative.

title: When a PID is deleted, the Wallet Unit shall erase the PID's attribute data and …
text: When a PID is deleted, the Wallet Unit shall erase the PID's attribute data and associated key material so that it cannot be recovered from the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Unit shall obtain confirmation from the Wallet User before deleting a…
text: The Wallet Unit shall obtain confirmation from the Wallet User before deleting a PID.

title: The Wallet Unit shall not notify the PID Provider of a user-initiated deletion o…
text: The Wallet Unit shall not notify the PID Provider of a user-initiated deletion of a PID.

title: The Wallet Unit shall inform the Wallet User, when they delete a PID, that delet…
text: The Wallet Unit shall inform the Wallet User, when they delete a PID, that deletion does not revoke the PID and that revocation must be requested separately if required.

title: The Wallet Provider shall sign the Wallet Instance software package using a priv…
text: The Wallet Provider shall sign the Wallet Instance software package using a private key associated with the Wallet Provider’s registered identity in the target distribution platform’s certificate infrastructure, such that the distribution platform or device can verify the signature before permitting installation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall distribute the Wallet Instance software exclusively th…
text: The Wallet Provider shall distribute the Wallet Instance software exclusively through distribution channels that enforce signature verification of the software package as a condition of delivery to the Wallet User’s device.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance verifies the integrity…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance verifies the integrity of its own software prior to initializing any Wallet Unit functionality, by performing a cryptographic check of the installed package against a reference value established at install time and protected within the device's hardware-backed key store or WSCD.

title: The Wallet Provider shall hold the private signing key used for the Wallet Insta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall hold the private signing key used for the Wallet Instance software package in a hardware security module (HSM) that requires multi-person authorisation for each signing operation and that is certified to FIPS 140-3 Level 3, Common Criteria EAL4+, or an equivalent recognised level.

title: The Wallet Provider shall record, in a tamper-evident log retained for at least …
text: The Wallet Provider shall record, in a tamper-evident log retained for at least 12 months, every administrative action that modifies the Wallet Instance software package, the code-signing infrastructure, or the configuration of the distribution channel, together with the identity of the operators and the time of the action.

title: The Wallet Provider shall verify, before incorporating any third-party software …
text: The Wallet Provider shall verify, before incorporating any third-party software component into a Wallet Instance software build, that the component's distribution origin is authenticated through a cryptographic signature or hash that traces to a publisher identity declared in the Wallet Provider's approved-supplier list.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, at installation and a…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, at installation and at each subsequent launch, verifies that the operating system version and security patch level of the host device meets the minimum requirements documented by the Wallet Provider, and refuses to activate Wallet Unit functionality on devices that do not meet those requirements.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance detects the presence o…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance detects the presence of root access or jailbreak conditions on the host device and, where such conditions are detected, refuses to finalize Wallet Instance Installation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall implement runtime anti-tampering controls in the Walle…
text: The Wallet Provider shall implement runtime anti-tampering controls in the Wallet Instance that detect attempts to instrument, hook, or modify the application's execution at runtime.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit refuses to finalize Wallet…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit refuses to finalize Wallet Instance installation when the runtime anti-tampering controls detect an attempt to instrument, hook, or modify the application's execution.

title: The Wallet Provider shall document and enforce minimum security requirements for…
text: The Wallet Provider shall document and enforce minimum security requirements for devices on which the Wallet Instance may be installed and operated, including at minimum: a screen lock mechanism using a PIN, password, or biometric factor; the availability of a hardware-backed key store; and a supported operating system version receiving security updates from the platform vendor.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device use…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device used by the Wallet Unit is operated solely under the Wallet Provider’s control, holds a valid security certification appropriate for the applicable Assurance Level prior to its first use by a Wallet Unit, and remains under the Wallet Provider’s exclusive operational control throughout the entire lifetime of the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall implement mechanisms in the Wallet Instance to detect …
text: The Wallet Provider shall implement mechanisms in the Wallet Instance to detect the presence of known malicious applications or anomalous runtime conditions on the host device that could expose Wallet Unit key material or credentials to unauthorised access, and shall, upon detection, prevent Wallet Unit operations involving access to key material until the threat is resolved.

title: The Wallet Provider shall distribute the Wallet Instance exclusively through the…
text: The Wallet Provider shall distribute the Wallet Instance exclusively through the official app store of the operating system of the Wallet User's device; or, where distribution through alternative channels is necessary, shall implement a mechanism enabling even a Wallet User with low digital savviness to verify the authenticity of the Wallet Instance prior to installation and shall provide the Wallet User with clear instructions for completing that verification.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance requests only those de…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance requests only those device permissions strictly necessary for the functioning of declared Wallet Unit features, and shall present the Wallet User with a plain-language explanation of the purpose of each permission at the time it is requested.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, at the time of instal…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, at the time of installation, operates within an operating system-enforced isolation boundary that prevents co-located applications from accessing, reading, or modifying data stored by the Wallet Instance, including PID credentials, Electronic Attestations of Attributes, cryptographic key material, and any personal data processed by the Wallet Instance.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance is shipped with a secu…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance is shipped with a secure default configuration such that no Wallet Unit functionality is accessible prior to completion of the initial activation process and no personal data is transmitted by the Wallet Instance before the Wallet User has accepted all required privacy disclosures.

title: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User, prior to completing installat…
text: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User, prior to completing installation of the Wallet Instance, with clear and comprehensible information about the nature of the wallet, the categories of personal data processed, the applicable terms and conditions, and the security responsibilities of the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet User is presented with the Wall…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet User is presented with the Wallet Provider's terms of service prior to completing installation of the Wallet Instance, that acceptance constitutes an explicit Wallet User action, and that the Wallet Instance is not operable until that acceptance has been recorded.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, prior to completing installation of the W…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, prior to completing installation of the Wallet Instance, the Wallet User is provided with a clear and complete description of all categories of personal data processed by the Wallet Unit, the purposes for which each category is processed, and the legal basis under Article 6 of the GDPR applicable to each processing activity.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all communication between the Wallet Insta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all communication between the Wallet Instance (WI) and the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Application (WSCA) during Wallet Unit activation is conducted over a channel that is mutually authenticated and integrity-protected, so that activation data cannot be intercepted, replayed, or tampered with by a third party.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys attested in a Key Attesta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys attested in a Key Attestation and all private keys of device-bound PIDs and attestations are generated within the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device (WSCD), and that those private keys are never extracted from the WSCD in the clear at any point during or after activation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall verify, before signing and issuing a Key Attestation, …
text: The Wallet Provider shall verify, before signing and issuing a Key Attestation, that the public keys to be included in that Key Attestation correspond to private keys that were generated by and are stored in the WSCA/WSCD described in that attestation, and that those private keys remain under the exclusive control of the Wallet User.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall, before issuing a Wallet Instance Attestation, verify …
text: The Wallet Provider shall, before issuing a Wallet Instance Attestation, verify that the requesting Wallet Instance is a genuine instance of its Wallet Solution and that the attestation request has not been replayed, forged, or submitted by an unauthorised party.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, during Wallet Unit ac…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance, during Wallet Unit activation, authenticates the Wallet Provider backend before transmitting any device or WSCD information, so that the Wallet Instance can verify it is communicating with the genuine Wallet Provider and not an impostor.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Key Attestation is cryptographically …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Key Attestation is cryptographically bound to the keystore of the Wallet Unit by including one or more public keys in the Key Attestation whose corresponding private keys are generated by and stored exclusively in the WSCA/WSCD of the Wallet Unit, so that each Key Attestation is tied to a specific, unique WSCD instance.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Key Attestation contains, at minimum:…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Key Attestation contains, at minimum: (a) information describing the storage type and the security certification of the WSCA/WSCD or keystore in which the attested private keys are stored; and (b) one or more public keys corresponding to private keys generated by and stored in that WSCA/WSCD or keystore.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Wallet Instance Attestation contains,…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Wallet Instance Attestation contains, at minimum: (a) information enabling PID Providers and Attestation Providers to check the revocation status of that Wallet Instance Attestation; and (b) a Wallet Unit identifier that does not enable tracking of the Wallet User across transactions.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall sign each Wallet Instance Attestation and each Key Att…
text: The Wallet Provider shall sign each Wallet Instance Attestation and each Key Attestation using only cryptographic algorithms included in the ECCG Agreed Cryptographic Mechanisms [6].

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall bind each Key Attestation to the specific issuance con…
text: The Wallet Provider shall bind each Key Attestation to the specific issuance context in which it is presented, either by incorporating a nonce provided by the PID Provider or Attestation Provider into the Key Attestation, or by presenting the Key Attestation together with a Proof-of-Possession signed over that nonce using a private key attested in that Key Attestation.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all unique elements of each Wallet Instanc…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all unique elements of each Wallet Instance Attestation and each Key Attestation — including the attestation identifier used for revocation status checking, the attested public keys, and the Wallet Provider's signature — have a negligible probability of having the same value across all such attestations issued by that Wallet Provider.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall manage the validity periods of Wallet Instance Attesta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall manage the validity periods of Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations such that a non-revoked Wallet Unit can at all times present a Wallet Instance Attestation and a Key Attestation each with a remaining validity period of at least 31 days, and shall set validity periods taking into account the risk that such an attestation could become a vector for tracking the Wallet User across multiple issuance transactions.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall re-issue Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestat…
text: The Wallet Provider shall re-issue Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations to a non-revoked Wallet Unit as needed throughout the lifetime of the Wallet Unit, ensuring continuity of the Wallet Unit's ability to receive PIDs and device-bound attestations without requiring re-activation.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that device binding for all PIDs and deviceboun…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that device binding for all PIDs and devicebound attestations is implemented by having the WSCA/WSCD or keystore generate a dedicated public-private key pair for each PID or device-bound attestation, and by ensuring that the corresponding private key is generated within and remains protected by the WSCA/WSCD or keystore throughout the lifetime of the attestation.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that every public key to which a PID or a devic…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that every public key to which a PID or a device-bound attestation is bound at issuance is a public key attested in a Key Attestation issued to that Wallet Unit.

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a documented policy governing t…
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a documented policy governing the issuance of Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations that satisfies the requirements of clauses 6 and 7 of [9].

section: 6.2 Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation Issuance
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the revocation-status-maintenance period o…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the revocation-status-maintenance period of each Wallet Instance Attestation and each Key Attestation it issues to a Wallet Unit is at least as long as the longest administrative validity period of any PID or device-bound Electronic Attestation of Attributes issued into that Wallet Unit on the basis of that Wallet Instance Attestation or Key Attestation, and that the revocation status is maintained throughout that period.

title: The Wallet Provider shall establish the binding between the Wallet Instance and …
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish the binding between the Wallet Instance and the Wallet Unit by issuing a Wallet Unit Attestation only to a Wallet Instance whose installation has been successfully verified through a platform-level attestation mechanism provided by the device operating system.

title: The Wallet Provider shall not use persistent device fingerprinting for fraud mon…
text: The Wallet Provider shall not use persistent device fingerprinting for fraud monitoring or risk assessment purposes; where device-specific identifiers are collected during activation for legitimate operational purposes, the Wallet Provider shall limit collection to the minimum necessary, shall not derive or retain a persistent fingerprint for Wallet User tracking, and shall inform the Wallet User in accordance with the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Wallet Instance holds cryptographic m…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each Wallet Instance holds cryptographic material that can be used to identify unambiguously the Wallet Instance in a way that this cryptographic data cannot be cloned to another device.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the WSCA authenticates the Wallet Instance…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the WSCA authenticates the Wallet Instance before performing any cryptographic operation on its behalf, by challenging the Wallet Instance to produce a proof of possession of the cryptographic data mentioned in ACT-5.3-03.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall offer the Wallet User the opportunity to authenticate …
text: The Wallet Provider shall offer the Wallet User the opportunity to authenticate to an existing Wallet User account before offering the creation of a new Wallet User account during Wallet Unit activation.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall not collect or process personal identity data about th…
text: The Wallet Provider shall not collect or process personal identity data about the Wallet User during Wallet Unit activation beyond what is strictly necessary to complete the activation process and to comply with applicable legal obligations.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any modification to the Wallet Unit accoun…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any modification to the Wallet Unit account configuration after activation requires authenticated and authorised proof from the Wallet Unit or, for emergency procedures, a fresh verification of the Wallet User's identity, and cannot be performed unilaterally by the Wallet Provider without the Wallet User's involvement.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with configurable privacy sett…
text: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with configurable privacy settings during activation, and shall ensure that the default configuration of any optional data processing activity is set to the option that minimises data collection unless the Wallet User has explicitly selected otherwise.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a Wallet User account mechanism…
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a Wallet User account mechanism that enables the Wallet User to request revocation of the Wallet Unit independently of physical access to the device on which the Wallet Instance is installed.

section: 6.4 Wallet User Account Setup with Wallet Provider
title: The Wallet Provider shall design the Wallet User account for revocation such tha…
text: The Wallet Provider shall design the Wallet User account for revocation such that the revocation mechanism is accessible to the Wallet User under adverse conditions — including loss of the device, physical displacement, limited access to communications, or a state of stress — while being sufficiently protected against unauthorised use to prevent a third party from revoking the Wallet Unit of another person without that person's authorisation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all authentication verification data assoc…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all authentication verification data associated with authentication factors enrolled during activation is stored either within the WSCA/WSCD or in platform-provided hardware-backed key storage, and is not accessible to any application other than the Wallet Instance.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each authentication factor enrolled during…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each authentication factor enrolled during Wallet Unit activation is cryptographically bound to that specific Wallet Unit, such that the same factor presented from any other device, copy, or instance cannot authenticate the holder for actions performed by the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit limits the number of conse…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit limits the number of consecutive unsuccessful authentication attempts for each knowledge-based factor to a value not exceeding ten, beyond which the factor is locked until the Wallet User re-establishes proof of holder identity through an out-of-band procedure operated by the Wallet Provider.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet User authentication mechanism e…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet User authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit activation consists of at least two factors of different categories, each verified by the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Application of the Wallet Unit, such that no Wallet Unit operation involving Person Identification Data, the Wallet Unit Attestation, or other attestations at security level High can complete based solely on the Wallet User-device operating-system authentication mechanism.

title: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with the option to restore a M…
text: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with the option to restore a Migration Object from another Wallet Unit from the Wallet User.

title: When the Wallet User provides a Migration Object, the Wallet Unit shall, upon re…
text: When the Wallet User provides a Migration Object, the Wallet Unit shall, upon receiving the decryption password from the Wallet User, import all data from the Migration Object.

title: After import of the data from a Migration Object, the Wallet Unit shall offer to…
text: After import of the data from a Migration Object, the Wallet Unit shall offer to guide the Wallet User through the re-issuance of the key bound PID and attestations, allowing the Wallet User to select which PID and EAA to have re-issued at that moment.

title: If the Wallet User has not chosen to re-issue all PID and EAA in one go, the Wal…
text: If the Wallet User has not chosen to re-issue all PID and EAA in one go, the Wallet User should have the opportunity to restart the process at a later stage.

title: The Wallet Unit shall support all restore mechanisms specified in [7].
text: The Wallet Unit shall support all restore mechanisms specified in [7].

title: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with an explicit choice about …
text: The Wallet Provider shall present the Wallet User with an explicit choice about whether to create a Migration Object during the Wallet Unit activation process, before the activation process is considered complete.

title: When presenting the Migration Object choice, the Wallet Provider shall inform th…
text: When presenting the Migration Object choice, the Wallet Provider shall inform the Wallet User in plain language that without a Migration Object: (a) there will be no list of PID and Wallet Bound EAA for the new Wallet Unit to request reissuance; (b) the transaction log will not be preserved, and the Wallet User will have no means to demonstrate past transactions in the event of a dispute, fraud, or security incident; (c) there will be no mechanism for migrating the non Wallet Bound EAA to a new Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall not complete Wallet Unit activation until the Wallet U…
text: The Wallet Provider shall not complete Wallet Unit activation until the Wallet User has explicitly confirmed their choice regarding the Migration Object.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet User chooses to create a Migration Object during …
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet User chooses to create a Migration Object during activation, the Wallet Unit shall require the Wallet User to designate a storage location for the Migration Object before the activation process is considered complete.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that at least one storage option offered for th…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that at least one storage option offered for the Migration Object is EU based and under the Wallet User’s exclusive control and is not a location controlled by the Wallet Provider.

title: The Wallet Unit shall create the Migration Object in accordance with [7].
text: The Wallet Unit shall create the Migration Object in accordance with [7].

section: 7.1 Security Requirements for Non-PID Use Cases
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that non-identity attestations stored in the Wa…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that non-identity attestations stored in the Wallet Unit are protected against unauthorised access or modification by mechanisms equivalent to those applied to PID credentials stored in the same Wallet Unit.

section: 7.1 Security Requirements for Non-PID Use Cases
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit discloses data from nonide…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit discloses data from nonidentity attestations only in response to a verified relying party request and only to the minimum extent necessary to fulfil that request.

section: 7.1 Security Requirements for Non-PID Use Cases
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit in the operational state w…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit in the operational state without PID does not complete presentations of credentials or attestations whose issuance or validity depends on a PID credential bound to that Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit generates and securely sto…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit generates and securely stores within the WSCD all key material required for PID issuance before initiating a PID issuance request with a PID Provider.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit presents the Wallet User w…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit presents the Wallet User with a clear description of the PID issuance process and obtains the Wallet User's explicit consent before initiating a PID issuance request with a PID Provider.

title: The Wallet Unit shall obtain the registration certificate of a PID Provider excl…
text: The Wallet Unit shall obtain the registration certificate of a PID Provider exclusively from the credential issuer metadata published by that PID Provider, as profiled in [5].

title: The Wallet Unit shall verify, prior to submitting a PID issuance request, that t…
text: The Wallet Unit shall verify, prior to submitting a PID issuance request, that the registration certificate and the access certificate of the PID Provider contain the same unique identifier for that PID Provider.

title: The Wallet Unit shall not submit a PID issuance request where the verification s…
text: The Wallet Unit shall not submit a PID issuance request where the verification specified in PID-8.1-02 does not confirm that both certificates contain the same unique identifier.

title: The Wallet Unit shall inform the Wallet User where verification of the PID Provi…
text: The Wallet Unit shall inform the Wallet User where verification of the PID Provider's registration certificate does not confirm that the PID Provider is registered and explain the danger to the Wallet User.

section: 8.2 Binding Wallet Unit to Wallet User Identity Verification
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit accepts PID only after the…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit accepts PID only after the PID Provider has confirmed, through identity proofing at Level of Assurance High as specified in [2], that the Wallet User is the natural person to whom the PID data uniquely and unambiguously corresponds.

section: 8.2 Binding Wallet Unit to Wallet User Identity Verification
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the identity proofing result presented by …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the identity proofing result presented by the PID Provider refers unambiguously to the same Wallet User session and Wallet Unit that initiated the PID issuance request, such that the result of identity proofing performed for one Wallet User cannot be redirected to a different Wallet Unit.

section: 8.2 Binding Wallet Unit to Wallet User Identity Verification
title: The Wallet Provider shall implement controls to detect and interrupt PID issuanc…
text: The Wallet Provider shall implement controls to detect and interrupt PID issuance flows that exhibit patterns inconsistent with legitimate first-time or renewal issuance for a single Wallet Unit, including repeated rapid issuance attempts and concurrent issuance sessions for the same Wallet Unit.

section: 8.2 Binding Wallet Unit to Wallet User Identity Verification
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that PID binding is initiated only upon verifie…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that PID binding is initiated only upon verified and cryptographically confirmed successful completion of the required identity verification steps, and that any PID issuance session associated with a failed, interrupted, or unverifiable identity verification result is rejected and cancelled prior to PID storage.

section: 8.2 Binding Wallet Unit to Wallet User Identity Verification
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit does not simultaneously st…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit does not simultaneously store more than one active PID credential purporting to identify the same natural person, and shall require the Wallet User to remove any existing active PID credential issued by a different PID Provider before a new PID credential from that different PID Provider can be accepted and stored.

title: The Wallet Unit shall verify, prior to accepting a PID credential, that the sign…
text: The Wallet Unit shall verify, prior to accepting a PID credential, that the signing certificate of the PID Provider that issued the credential traces to a trust anchor published by the European Commission in the list of trusted entities applicable to PID Providers.

title: The Wallet Unit shall reject a PID credential whose signing certificate traces t…
text: The Wallet Unit shall reject a PID credential whose signing certificate traces to a trust anchor other than a trust anchor published by the European Commission in the list of trusted entities applicable to PID Providers, established in accordance with [12].

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, for each PID issuance, the Wallet Unit ge…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, for each PID issuance, the Wallet Unit generates a dedicated asymmetric key pair (the PID binding key pair) within the Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device (WSCD), and that the PID issuance request submitted to the PID Provider includes a cryptographic proof of possession of the PID binding private key together with a Key Attestation from the Wallet Provider confirming that the PID binding private key is generated, stored within, and non-extractable from the WSCD.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID Provider binds the issued PID cred…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID Provider binds the issued PID credential to the PID binding public key, such that the credential can only be presented by the Wallet Unit holding the corresponding PID binding private key.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon any PID issuance or re-issuance, the…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon any PID issuance or re-issuance, the Wallet Unit generates a PID binding key pair that is unique to that issuance event and has not been used as the PID binding key pair for any other PID credential issued to the same Wallet Unit, so that the compromise of one PID binding private key does not affect the security of any other PID credential.

title: The Wallet Unit shall verify the cryptographic integrity and authenticity of a r…
text: The Wallet Unit shall verify the cryptographic integrity and authenticity of a received PID credential before storing it, including verification of the PID Provider's digital signature over the credential, the credential's validity period, and conformance of the credential format with the applicable technical specification.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the delivery of a PID credential from the …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the delivery of a PID credential from the PID Provider to the Wallet Unit takes place in conformance with the requirements specified in ETSI TS 119 472-3 [5], applying any additional protective measures required to prevent observation, modification, or interception of the credential payload by parties intermediating the communication path.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, before the Wallet Unit signs the proof of…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, before the Wallet Unit signs the proof of possession that binds a PID credential to the Wallet Unit, the Wallet User has successfully authenticated to the Wallet Unit using the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit activation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID binding private key associated wit…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID binding private key associated with each issued PID credential is generated within the WSCD of the Wallet Unit, stored exclusively within that WSCD, and protected from extraction in plaintext form throughout the lifecycle of that PID credential.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all personal data stored by the Wallet Ins…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all personal data stored by the Wallet Instance, including Person Identification Data, Electronic Attestations of Attributes, transaction log entries, and any other personal data of the Wallet User, is encrypted at rest using a cryptographic key whose use is authorized only after successful Wallet User authentication via the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit activation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires successful Wallet…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires successful Wallet User authentication before presenting any PID credential to a relying party, using the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit activation at the assurance level applicable to the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires successful Wallet…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires successful Wallet User authentication, using the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit activation, before rendering any value of a Person Identification Data attribute in its Wallet User interface.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID activation process verifies, throu…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the PID activation process verifies, through the authentication mechanism established during Wallet Unit Activation, that the Wallet User completing the activation is the same individual who initiated PID issuance, before the Wallet Unit transitions to a state in which PID presentation is permitted.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires the Wallet User's…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires the Wallet User's explicit confirmation before marking a received PID credential as active and available for presentation to relying parties.

title: The Wallet Provider shall apply the same documented change-control, codesigning,…
text: The Wallet Provider shall apply the same documented change-control, codesigning, and distribution-channel controls to every Wallet Instance software update as those required for initial deployment, such that no update bypasses or relaxes the controls established for the original software release.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each update to the Wallet Instance is veri…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that each update to the Wallet Instance is verified, before deployment, to confirm that the update does not remove or reduce the operating system-level isolation mechanisms that protect data stored by the Wallet Instance from access by co-located applications, and shall refuse to apply an update that would reduce the Wallet Instance's isolation capabilities below the level verified during installation.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Provider permits rollback to a previous software …
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Provider permits rollback to a previous software version of the Wallet Instance, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that the rollback does not result in the reinstatement of a version with known security vulnerabilities or a reduction of the security baseline established by the version in force before the rollback.

title: The Wallet Provider shall notify the Wallet User when an update to the Wallet In…
text: The Wallet Provider shall notify the Wallet User when an update to the Wallet Instance is available.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where an update to the Wallet Instance remediates a security vulne…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where an update to the Wallet Instance remediates a security vulnerability or is necessary to maintain the security baseline of the Wallet Unit, the Wallet Provider shall make the installation of that update a precondition for continued use of the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall define and enforce a maximum inactivity period after w…
text: The Wallet Provider shall define and enforce a maximum inactivity period after which an authenticated session within the Wallet Unit is automatically invalidated and the Wallet User is required to re-authenticate before any Wallet Unit operation may proceed.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires Wallet User re-au…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires Wallet User re-authentication before performing any sensitive operation, including presentation of credentials to a relying party, modification of enrolled authentication factors, and access to stored PID or attestation data following session expiry.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit does not retain PID data o…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit does not retain PID data or other personal data in unprotected memory or storage beyond the scope of a single presentation transaction, and that any temporary copies of such data created during a transaction are securely erased upon completion or termination of that transaction.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cryptographic key material subject to …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cryptographic key material subject to rotation is generated within the WSCD and remains within the WSCD throughout the key rotation process, and that superseded key material is irrevocably deleted from the WSCD upon successful completion of rotation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that key rotation and Wallet Unit software upda…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that key rotation and Wallet Unit software update operations are performed in a manner that preserves the security level of the Wallet Unit throughout the operation, such that no transient or permanent reduction in cryptographic strength occurs, and that any operation that cannot be completed without reducing security is automatically aborted and the Wallet Unit restored to its pre-operation security state.

title: The Wallet Provider shall implement and document procedures for renewing Wallet …
text: The Wallet Provider shall implement and document procedures for renewing Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations before their expiry date and shall ensure that the expiry of such an attestation does not cause an unplanned interruption to Wallet Unit availability.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that renewal of the Wallet Instance Attestation…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that renewal of the Wallet Instance Attestation and the Key Attestation and re-issuance of PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes during the maintenance phase applies the same security controls, cryptographic key generation procedures, and assurance requirements as the initial issuance process for the same credential type, and shall not implement a renewal path that bypasses or reduces any security requirement that applied during initial issuance.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon expiry of the validity period of a P…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon expiry of the validity period of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes, the Wallet Unit refuses to present the expired credential to any Relying Party.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a PID credential or El…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes by its Provider, the Wallet Unit refuses to present the revoked credential to any Relying Party, and shall implement a mechanism to check and maintain awareness of the revocation status of all PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes stored in the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit clearly indicates the expi…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit clearly indicates the expired or revoked status of any PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes in any Wallet User interface that displays the credential.

title: The Wallet Provider shall apply, to every renewal or re-issuance of a PID creden…
text: The Wallet Provider shall apply, to every renewal or re-issuance of a PID credential or Electronic Attestation of Attributes to the Wallet Unit, the same authentication, identity-proofing, and cryptographic-binding requirements as those required for the initial issuance of that credential type.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit provides the Wallet User w…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit provides the Wallet User with the ability to delete individual attestations, and that deletion results in the removal of the credential data from the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon deletion of a PID credential or an E…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon deletion of a PID credential or an Electronic Attestation of Attributes from the Wallet Unit, every registration of that credential with an operating system interface through which relying parties can request its presentation is removed.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all Wallet User support processes for Wall…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all Wallet User support processes for Wallet Unit-related requests include verification of the Wallet User's identity before any action affecting the Wallet Unit account is taken by support staff.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any process by which a Wallet User who is …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any process by which a Wallet User who is unable to authenticate using an existing enrolled authentication factor resets that authentication factor requires identity re-verification at an assurance level equivalent to the assurance level of the Wallet Unit before the reset is permitted.

title: The Wallet Provider shall establish, maintain, and communicate to the Users a cl…
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish, maintain, and communicate to the Users a clear and accessible procedure through which a Wallet User can report the confirmed or suspected loss or theft of the device hosting the Wallet Unit without requiring physical access to the original device.

title: The Wallet Provider shall, upon receiving a credible report of loss or theft of …
text: The Wallet Provider shall, upon receiving a credible report of loss or theft of the device hosting a Wallet Unit, revoke that Wallet Unit promptly and prior to establishing any replacement Wallet Unit for the same Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the process for establishing a replacement…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the process for establishing a replacement Wallet Unit following a confirmed or suspected compromise of the existing Wallet Unit or its authentication factors applies the same security requirements as the initial installation and activation process, including identity verification at the applicable Assurance Level for each credential type to be re-issued.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revocation of a Wallet Unit, or the esta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revocation of a Wallet Unit, or the establishment of a replacement Wallet Unit under MAINT-9.5-05, that support staff carry out on behalf of a Wallet User takes effect only after a second member of staff has approved it.

title: The Wallet Provider shall record the two approvals under MAINT-9.5-06 in a log t…
text: The Wallet Provider shall record the two approvals under MAINT-9.5-06 in a log that is protected against undetected modification.

title: The Wallet Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum…
text: The Wallet Provider shall determine, as part of its risk assessment, the maximum time within which the second approval under MAINT-9.5-06 is given.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the second approval under MAINT9.5-06 is g…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the second approval under MAINT9.5-06 is given within the maximum time determined under MAINT-9.5-08.

title: The Wallet Provider shall document the scope and limitations of the Wallet Unit …
text: The Wallet Provider shall document the scope and limitations of the Wallet Unit backup mechanism (the Migration Object), including which data elements are included in and excluded from the backup, and shall communicate these limitations to the Wallet User before the Wallet User activate the automated backup creation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any backup is encrypted before being store…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that any backup is encrypted before being stored or transmitted outside the Wallet Unit, using an encryption password that is known only to the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall inform the Wallet User that the encryption password sh…
text: The Wallet Provider shall inform the Wallet User that the encryption password should be stored separately from the backup in a location that is only accessible to the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the confidentiality of the backup data doe…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the confidentiality of the backup data does not depend on the storage location, such that the backup remains unreadable to the Wallet Provider and to the operator of any storage location offered or used, and the ability to decrypt it rests solely on a secret held by the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that when a Wallet User restores a backup to a …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that when a Wallet User restores a backup to a different device the target Wallet Unit will remind the Wallet User to revoke the source Wallet Unit if it will no longer be used by the Wallet User and provide him with any information that the Wallet Provider may collect that would help the Wallet User to do so.

title: The Wallet Provider shall update the Migration Object to reflect the current sta…
text: The Wallet Provider shall update the Migration Object to reflect the current state of all PID credentials, attestations, and transaction log entries after every transaction performed by the Wallet Unit. A transaction for the purposes of this requirement includes any presentation of a PID or EAA to a relying party, any issuance or deletion of an attestation, and any key rotation event.

title: The Wallet Provider shall not present a Migration Object to the Wallet User as c…
text: The Wallet Provider shall not present a Migration Object to the Wallet User as current if the Migration Object does not reflect the most recently confirmed wallet state, without displaying an accompanying notification that the Migration Object is outdated.

title: [CONDITIONAL] The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, where the Wallet Unit canno…
text: [CONDITIONAL] The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, where the Wallet Unit cannot update the Migration Object because the storage location selected by the Wallet User is no longer accessible to it, the Wallet Unit prompts the Wallet User to restore access to that location or to select a new storage location.

title: The Wallet Provider shall monitor the continued adequacy of the authentication f…
text: The Wallet Provider shall monitor the continued adequacy of the authentication factors associated with each Wallet Unit for the applicable Assurance Level and shall require the Wallet User to establish new or updated authentication factors — through a process that meets the same security requirements as the initial activation — where the operating system, Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device, or applicable conformity framework indicates that existing factors no longer meet the requirements for the applicable Assurance Level.

title: The Wallet Provider shall conduct documented periodic reviews of the security co…
text: The Wallet Provider shall conduct documented periodic reviews of the security controls and procedures governing the Wallet Unit infrastructure, at intervals not exceeding twelve months, to verify that the controls remain effective and continue to satisfy the requirements for the applicable Assurance Level, and shall document identified findings and implement remediation within a timeframe commensurate with the severity of each finding.

title: The Wallet Provider shall maintain a documented data management policy that spec…
text: The Wallet Provider shall maintain a documented data management policy that specifies, for each category of operational record generated during the Wallet Unit's active lifetime, the legal basis for retention, the defined retention period, the storage protection requirements, and the deletion or anonymisation mechanism, and shall implement and consistently apply this policy across all Wallet Units and associated backend systems.

title: The Wallet Provider shall retrieve, at intervals not exceeding 24 hours, the cur…
text: The Wallet Provider shall retrieve, at intervals not exceeding 24 hours, the current version of each trusted list as specified in [8] and of each list of trusted entities established in accordance with [12] that is applicable to the parties with which its Wallet Units interact.

title: The Wallet Provider shall distribute to every non-revoked Wallet Unit each trust…
text: The Wallet Provider shall distribute to every non-revoked Wallet Unit each trust anchor that has been newly published in a list retrieved under MAINT-9.9-01.

title: The Wallet Provider shall withdraw from every valid Wallet Unit each trust ancho…
text: The Wallet Provider shall withdraw from every valid Wallet Unit each trust anchor that has been removed from, or invalidated in, a list retrieved under MAINT-9.9-01.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet Unit accepts only the trust ancho…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet Unit accepts only the trust anchors distributed to it by the Wallet Provider under MAINT-9.9-02.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that migration of a Wallet Unit is initiated so…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that migration of a Wallet Unit is initiated solely by the Wallet User from the source Wallet Unit, including where the target Wallet Unit is operated by a different Wallet Provider, and that no authorisation, approval, or notification by the Wallet Provider is required as a precondition for initiating migration.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that at all times an updated Migration Object w…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that at all times an updated Migration Object will be available in the storage location selected by the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Migration Object is stored in external…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Migration Object is stored in external or remote storage only in an encrypted form that protects its confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity, and that only the Wallet User holds the cryptographic material required to decrypt it.

title: Prior to presenting the Wallet User with the option to finalise migration and re…
text: Prior to presenting the Wallet User with the option to finalise migration and revoke the source Wallet Unit, the Wallet Provider shall verify that the target Wallet Unit is in an active state.

title: The Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit upon the Wallet User’s e…
text: The Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit upon the Wallet User’s explicit decision to finalise the migration.

title: The Wallet Provider shall not prevent or delay revocation of the source Wallet U…
text: The Wallet Provider shall not prevent or delay revocation of the source Wallet Unit on the grounds that the Wallet User has not yet requested reissuance of some or all Electronic Attestations of Attributes held in the source Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, before completing Wallet Unit reestablish…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, before completing Wallet Unit reestablishment on the target device, the target device undergoes the same device security assessment as is required during Wallet Instance installation, including verification that the device meets the minimum hardware and software security requirements defined in the Wallet Provider's security policy and that a WSCD meeting the applicable security certification requirements is available on the target device.

section: 10.4 Wallet Unit Re-establishment on New Device
title: The Wallet Provider shall issue a new Wallet Instance Attestation and a new Key …
text: The Wallet Provider shall issue a new Wallet Instance Attestation and a new Key Attestation for the new device following the same security verification process applied during their initial issuance, including WSCD certification verification and platform attestation.

section: 10.4 Wallet Unit Re-establishment on New Device
title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that device binding on the new device is establ…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that device binding on the new device is established using a key pair newly generated within the WSCD of the new device and that no device-bound private key is transferred from the old device to the new device.

section: 10.4 Wallet Unit Re-establishment on New Device
title: The Wallet Provider shall require the Wallet User to establish authentication fa…
text: The Wallet Provider shall require the Wallet User to establish authentication factors on the target device through a procedure that meets the same security requirements as the initial setup of authentication factors during Wallet Unit activation, prior to the migration process being considered complete.

title: The Wallet Provider shall point out the dangers to the Wallet User of a valid Wa…
text: The Wallet Provider shall point out the dangers to the Wallet User of a valid Wallet Unit that is not under control of the Wallet User and ask the Wallet User if the old Wallet Unit should be revoked.

title: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall start the process to revoke the old Wallet Unit.

title: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is not managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall give the best possible instructions to the Wallet User what actions the Wallet User should undertake in order to get the old Wallet Unit revoked.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all key material held by the WSCD, all PID…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all key material held by the WSCD, all PID credentials and Electronic Attestations of Attributes, and all personal data stored by the Wallet Instance are permanently and irrecoverably deleted from the device before the Wallet Instance uninstallation process completes.

title: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If the Wallet User has indicated a need for the old Wallet Unit to be revoked and the old Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that that all cryptographic key material and personal data stored in the old Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted from the old device and that the Wallet Instance is uninstalled from the old device the next time when the Wallet Instance connects again with the WSCA.

section: 10.6 Secure Deletion of Keys and Attestations on Old Device
title: The Wallet Provider shall verify that the deletion of all cryptographic key mate…
text: The Wallet Provider shall verify that the deletion of all cryptographic key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has completed, and shall record the outcome of that verification.

section: 10.6 Secure Deletion of Keys and Attestations on Old Device
title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the sour…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has not been confirmed within a period defined and documented by the Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit irrespective of that confirmation.

section: 10.6 Secure Deletion of Keys and Attestations on Old Device
title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the sour…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the deletion of key material and personal data from the source Wallet Unit has been confirmed under MIG-10.6-01, the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit if it has not already been revoked.

section: 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable
title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the source Wallet Unit is no longer accessible to the Wallet…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the source Wallet Unit is no longer accessible to the Wallet User, the Wallet Provider shall enable the Wallet User to re-establish the Wallet Unit on a new device by restoring a Migration Object, without requiring any participation by the source device.

section: 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable
title: The Wallet Provider shall require identity proofing at the assurance level appli…
text: The Wallet Provider shall require identity proofing at the assurance level applicable to initial PID issuance before any PID credential is re-issued during a recovery performed under this clause.

section: 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable
title: [CONDITIONAL] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wal…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wallet Unit is managed by the same Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall revoke the source Wallet Unit, treating the Wallet User’s assertion that the source device is no longer under their control as the trigger for that revocation.

section: 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable
title: [CONDITIONAL] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wal…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where a recovery under this clause is performed and the source Wallet Unit is managed by a different Wallet Provider, the Wallet Provider shall give the Wallet User the best possible instructions on the actions the Wallet User should undertake in order to get the source Wallet Unit revoked.

section: 10.7 Recovery to a New Device When the Source Device Is Unavailable
title: The Wallet Provider shall apply to the re-establishment of the Wallet Unit on th…
text: The Wallet Provider shall apply to the re-establishment of the Wallet Unit on the new device under this clause the same new device security verification and reestablishment controls that apply to a migration, as set out in clauses 10.3 and 10.4.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires an explicit confi…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Unit requires an explicit confirmation step from the Wallet User before proceeding with uninstallation and presents the Wallet User with a clear statement of the consequences of uninstallation, including the irreversible loss of all key bound credentials stored in the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall, prior to completing the Wallet Instance uninstallatio…
text: The Wallet Provider shall, prior to completing the Wallet Instance uninstallation process, inform the Wallet User that all PID credentials, attestations and transaction logs stored in the Wallet Unit will be permanently deleted and are not recoverable after uninstallation, and shall require explicit Wallet User confirmation before proceeding.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, prior to completing the Wallet Instance u…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, prior to completing the Wallet Instance uninstallation process, an updated Migration Object is available in the storage location selected by the Wallet User, that the Wallet User confirms to still have access to that location and verify that the Wallet User still has knowledge of the Migration Object.

title: [CONDITIONAL] If one of the checks in UNINST-11.1-03 is not met, the Wallet Prov…
text: [CONDITIONAL] If one of the checks in UNINST-11.1-03 is not met, the Wallet Provider shall ensure that Wallet Unit uninstallation only proceeds after renewed confirmation by the Wallet User.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all active sessions and pending transactio…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all active sessions and pending transactions within the Wallet Unit are terminated before the uninstallation process begins.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Provider backend is notified of…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Provider backend is notified of the uninstallation event before or upon completion of the uninstallation process, enabling the Wallet Provider to initiate appropriate deregistration or revocation actions.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys associated with the Walle…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys associated with the Wallet Unit, including keys attested in a Key Attestation, credential-binding keys, and Wallet User authentication keys, are irrecoverably deleted from the WSCD and from all application storage locations during uninstallation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all PID credentials and attestations store…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all PID credentials and attestations stored in the Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted during uninstallation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cached data, temporary files, session …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all cached data, temporary files, session tokens, and application state related to Wallet Unit operations are irrecoverably deleted during uninstallation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the WSCA and WSCD are cleared of all key m…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the WSCA and WSCD are cleared of all key material, configuration data, and application-specific data stored within them as part of the uninstallation process.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon Wallet Instance uninstallation, all …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon Wallet Instance uninstallation, all operational records and transaction logs associated with the uninstalled Wallet Unit that are held in the Wallet Provider's backend systems are either deleted or anonymised in accordance with the applicable data protection requirements, except where those records are required to be retained under a legal obligation, in which case the retained records shall be limited to what is strictly necessary, retained only for the minimum required period, and access-controlled to prevent use for any purpose other than compliance with that obligation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall revoke the Wallet Instance Attestation and the Key Att…
text: The Wallet Provider shall revoke the Wallet Instance Attestation and the Key Attestation associated with a Wallet Unit at the time of Wallet Instance uninstallation regardless of whether the Wallet User intends to install the Wallet Instance again on the same or a different device.

title: The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with confirmation that the uni…
text: The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with confirmation that the uninstallation process has completed, including confirmation that the Wallet Unit has been deregistered with the Wallet Provider and has been revoked.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the uninstallation process results in no r…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the uninstallation process results in no recoverable Wallet Unit data remaining on the device, including private keys, credentials, cached data, and application configuration files.

title: The Wallet Provider shall implement mechanisms to detect security breaches affec…
text: The Wallet Provider shall implement mechanisms to detect security breaches affecting Wallet Units, including monitoring for indicators of device compromise, and shall initiate revocation procedures upon confirmed detection of a breach affecting a Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit when required to do so by applica…
text: The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit when required to do so by applicable law or by a competent supervisory authority, within the timeframes mandated by the applicable legal requirement.

title: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a documented procedure for acce…
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish and maintain a documented procedure for accepting and processing requests for permanent revocation of a Wallet Unit submitted by an authorised party other than the Wallet Unit holder, including requests submitted in consequence of the death or legal incapacity of the natural person to whom the Wallet Unit is issued, and shall provide a mechanism that enables such requests to be submitted and verified without requiring participation of the Wallet Unit holder.

title: The Wallet Provider shall establish processes for Wallet Users or other competen…
text: The Wallet Provider shall establish processes for Wallet Users or other competent parties to notify suspected device compromise.

title: The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit for which credible evidence of fr…
text: The Wallet Provider shall revoke a Wallet Unit for which credible evidence of fraudulent use or sufficient indication of suspected compromise has been identified and shall record the basis and supporting evidence for the revocation decision.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet User can initiate revocation of t…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a Wallet User can initiate revocation of their own Wallet Unit through a means that does not depend on access to the Wallet Unit’s device, on authentication factors or credentials that are typically kept or carried together with that device, or on any secret or credential that the Wallet User would typically only store in a fixed location such as their home.

title: The Wallet Provider shall, after authenticating the PID Provider as the sender, …
text: The Wallet Provider shall, after authenticating the PID Provider as the sender, revoke a Wallet Unit when the PID Provider forwards a request for revocation of that Wallet Unit on behalf of the person in whose name a PID was issued to it.

title: The Wallet Provider shall treat a notice from the PID Provider of the decease of…
text: The Wallet Provider shall treat a notice from the PID Provider of the decease of a Wallet Holder as a request under REV-12.1-03 for permanent revocation of the Wallet Unit to which the notice relates.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation requests submitted by parties o…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation requests submitted by parties other than the Wallet User are subject to verification of the authority of the requesting party to trigger revocation before the request is acted upon.
