title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revoked Wallet Unit is disabled within a…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that a revoked Wallet Unit is disabled within a defined maximum timeframe following the revocation decision.

title: The Wallet Provider shall document and enforce that maximum permissible delay be…
text: The Wallet Provider shall document and enforce that maximum permissible delay between the revocation decision and the effective disabling of the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a Wallet Unit, the rev…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, upon revocation of a Wallet Unit, the revocation status of the associated Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation is published to the applicable revocation status mechanism without undue delay, enabling parties interacting with the Wallet Unit to detect the revocation prior to accepting transactions with the revoked Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance ceases to display the …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance ceases to display the European Digital Identity Wallet Trust Mark referred to in [13] from the moment the Wallet Instance Attestation of that Wallet Unit is revoked.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation of a Wallet Unit is permanent a…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that revocation of a Wallet Unit is permanent and irreversible, and shall not provide any mechanism, interface, process, or administrative function through which a permanently revoked Wallet Unit can be restored to an active or operational state.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance Attestation issued to …
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the Wallet Instance Attestation issued to each Wallet Unit contains a reference to the revocation status mechanism maintained by the Wallet Provider, enabling relying parties and PID Providers to determine the current revocation status of the Wallet Unit at the time of any transaction.

title: The Wallet Provider shall, whenever it revokes the Wallet Instance Attestation o…
text: The Wallet Provider shall, whenever it revokes the Wallet Instance Attestation of a Wallet Unit — on revocation of the Wallet Unit under this clause, on uninstallation of the Wallet Instance, or on revocation of a source Wallet Unit during migration — set to revoked the revocation status of every Wallet Instance Attestation it has issued to that Wallet Unit, including any such attestation whose technical validity period has expired but whose revocation status the Wallet Provider still maintains, so that the revocation status reference recorded by a PID Provider or Attestation Provider at issuance reflects the revocation throughout the lifetime of the PID or attestation issued against it.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the revocation status of the Wallet Instan…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that the revocation status of the Wallet Instance Attestation and of the Key Attestation is published to the applicable attestation status list within a defined and documented maximum time period following the triggering event for revocation, and shall make that attestation status list available in a format and at a location that enables PID Providers and Attestation Providers to query the revocation status of any such attestation without requiring authenticated access to the status service.

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is is…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is issued in the mobile document format specified in [11], the Wallet Provider shall publish its revocation status by means of an attestation status list or an attestation revocation list as specified in [12].

title: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is is…
text: [CONDITIONAL] Where the Wallet Instance Attestation or the Key Attestation is issued in the selectively disclosable JSON Web Token verifiable credential format, the Wallet Provider shall publish its revocation status by means of an attestation status list as specified in [10].

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys stored in the remote WSCD…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that all private keys stored in the remote WSCD that are associated with a revoked Wallet Unit are irrecoverably deleted and that the revocation event is recorded in a tamper-evident audit log.

title: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, following permanent revocation of a Walle…
text: The Wallet Provider shall ensure that, following permanent revocation of a Wallet Unit, all personal data associated with the revoked Wallet Unit that is held in the Wallet Provider's backend systems is deleted or anonymised in accordance with the applicable data protection requirements, except where those records are required to be retained under a legal obligation, in which case the retained data shall be limited to what is strictly necessary, retained only for the minimum required period, and access-controlled to prevent use for any purpose other than compliance with that obligation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall retain audit logs related to Wallet Unit revocation fo…
text: The Wallet Provider shall retain audit logs related to Wallet Unit revocation for a period sufficient to support legal proceedings, supervisory audit, and incident investigation, and shall ensure that the retention period does not exceed the maximum period permitted under applicable data protection law.

title: The Wallet Provider shall operate a monitoring capability that detects, across e…
text: The Wallet Provider shall operate a monitoring capability that detects, across every lifecycle state of a Wallet Unit, patterns indicative of compromise or fraudulent use in the backend interactions it receives from that Wallet Unit, including a frequency of those interactions inconsistent with normal operation and a device or Wallet Secure Cryptographic Device profile presented in an interaction that is inconsistent with the profile recorded for that Wallet Unit at activation or at a subsequent re-attestation.

title: The Wallet Provider shall document, for each anomaly condition detected under MO…
text: The Wallet Provider shall document, for each anomaly condition detected under MON-13.1-01, the investigation procedure applied and the response available, up to and including revocation of the Wallet Unit.

title: The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with a means of reporting susp…
text: The Wallet Provider shall provide the Wallet User with a means of reporting suspected compromise or misuse of a Wallet Unit that does not require the Wallet User to authenticate to that Wallet Unit.

title: [CONDITIONAL] For a Wallet Unit that holds no PID credential, the Wallet Provide…
text: [CONDITIONAL] For a Wallet Unit that holds no PID credential, the Wallet Provider shall base the monitoring required under MON-13.1-01 on the Wallet Instance Attestation and Key Attestation status queries, the software update check-ins, and the reports of suspected compromise that it receives from the Wallet Unit at that stage.

title: [CONDITIONAL] For a Wallet Unit that holds a PID credential, the Wallet Provider…

text: The Wallet Provider shall monitor the application distribution channels through which the Wallet Instance is made available for counterfeit, modified, or look-alike applications that impersonate the Wallet Instance.

text: The Wallet Provider shall, upon identifying a counterfeit, modified, or lookalike application that impersonates the Wallet Instance, pursue its removal from the application distribution channel on which it is offered.

text: The Wallet Provider shall monitor for websites that impersonate the Wallet Provider in order to deceive Wallet Users.

text: The Wallet Provider shall, upon identifying a website that impersonates the Wallet Provider or the Wallet Instance, pursue its takedown.

title: The Wallet Provider shall maintain a means of contacting the Wallet User over a …
text: The Wallet Provider shall maintain a means of contacting the Wallet User over a push channel that the Wallet User will see without opening the Wallet Instance and that is independent of the Wallet Instance, for use in warning the Wallet User when compromise of the Wallet Unit is suspected.
